meta.source: Prydwen.gg NIKKE 가이드(Team Building, Meta Teams - Story/Tribe Tower, Teams Database, Tier List 변경 이력) 및 니케 위키를 참고해 정리한 2차 자료. 원문을 그대로 인용하지 않고 우리말로 재구성/요약함. 캐릭터 이름은 데이터베이스(characterDatabase.json)의 title/name_kr 기준. 2026-07-31부터는 사용자가 지정한 니케 유튜버 4인(고뇨/스페란도/에펜바움/김진서)의 최근 영상 내용도 1순위 자료로 반영.
meta.updateNote: 새 공략/패치 정보를 확인할 때마다 archetypes, synergyPairs, counters 배열에 계속 항목을 추가해 나갈 것. 이 파일은 조합 추천 스코어링 엔진의 '근거 자료'로 쓰인다. 2026-07-31: 7/23 패치(신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로, 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시)와 관련해 스페란도(유튜버) 영상들에서 반복적으로 소개된 PVP 조합을 1건 추가함(archetypes 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck', synergyPairs 마지막 항목). 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 추가 확인 필요. 2026-08-04: 주간 조사 결과 반영 — archetypes에 'wind-laplace-maxwell'(풍라플/풍맥덱, 스페란도 출처, 맥스웰 기여도에 대한 이견 있음), 'swha-alt-marciana'(마르차나: 마린 스터디를 스노우화이트: 헤비암즈 대체픽으로 활용, 김진서 출처) 2건 추가. 기존 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck'(피뻥덱)과는 별개의 조합임. (2026-08-07: prydwen 개별 캐릭터 Team 탭 447개 임포트 중 실제로는 5인 팀 시너지를 설명하지 않고 캐릭터 1명에 대한 일반 조언이거나 내용 없는 플레이스홀더였던 항목 72개를 품질 검수 후 제거함.)

burstPhase.rule: 버스트 게이지는 I -> II -> III 순서로만 진행된다. 각 단계에서 10초 안에 해당 버스트 타입 캐릭터가 스킬을 쓰지 않으면 게이지가 처음부터 다시 쌓인다. 팀에 버스트 I/II/III가 각각 최소 1명씩 없으면 풀버스트(4단계)에 도달할 수 없다.
burstPhase.implication: 5인 조합을 짤 때 버스트 I/II/III 세 타입이 모두 포함돼야 한다는 것은 취향이 아니라 강제 규칙. 스코어링에서 이 조건 미충족 시 크게 감점(사실상 탈락)해야 함.

autoSkillOrder.rule: 오토스킬(자동전투) 사용 시, 왼쪽부터 오른쪽 순서로 버스트I -> II -> III 캐릭터를 각각 한 명씩 찾아 스킬을 사용한다. 같은 타입이 여러 명이면 왼쪽에 배치된 캐릭터가 우선 사용되고, 쿨타임/사망/스턴 상태면 다음 순번으로 넘어간다.
autoSkillOrder.implication: 같은 버스트 타입이 팀에 2명 이상 있을 때는 배치 순서와 쿨타임 조합이 실제 발동 캐릭터를 결정한다. 상세 배치 최적화는 향후 고도화 대상.

burstSkillCooldown.rule: 버스트 스킬 쿨타임은 캐릭터마다 다르며 보통 20초 또는 40초. 쿨타임이 짧을수록(20초) 풀버스트 진입 빈도가 높아진다.
burstSkillCooldown.implication: 버스트 I/II 캐릭터는 쿨타임 20초 여부가 '풀버스트 안정성' 점수의 핵심 요소. characterDatabase.json의 skills[].cd 값을 그대로 활용 가능.

cdr.concept: CDR(Cooldown Reduction, 쿨타임 감소)은 아군 버스트/스킬 쿨타임을 줄여주는 효과로, 풀버스트 사이클 속도를 좌우하는 핵심 자원. 기본공격 트리거형(D: 킬러 와이프, 루주), 버스트 트리거형(솔린: 프로스트 티켓, 도로시) 등 발동 조건이 캐릭터마다 다름.
cdr.implication: 팀에 CDR 제공 캐릭터가 최소 1명 있는지가 고티어 조합의 필수 조건 중 하나로 자주 언급됨. 스코어링에서 CDR 보유 여부를 가산 요소로 넣을 것.

formations.2-1-2: 버스트I 2명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 2명. 유연하고 안정적이며 초반/자원이 부족할 때 기본형. 특정 무기 특화 조합에도 적합(서포터가 더 필요하므로).
formations.1-1-3: 버스트I 1명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 3명. 화력은 극대화되지만 버스트I/II가 최상급이 아니면 생존력이 부족해짐. 고investment 팀에 적합.

elementCycle.rule: 물이 불에게, 불이 바람에게, 바람이 철에게, 철이 전기에게, 전기가 물에게 상성 우위(피해량 +10%)를 가지는 순환 구조. 상성 보너스는 10%로 비교적 작아서 버스트 궁합/CDR/역할 구성보다 우선순위가 낮음.
elementCycle.implication: 스코어링에서 원소 상성은 가벼운 보너스 가중치로만 반영하고, 절대적 기준으로 삼지 않을 것.

archetypes.name: 베스갓(베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드 원맨아미)
archetypes.note: 버스트/논버스트, 버퍼 유무와 상관없이 혼자서 캠페인을 밀어붙일 수 있는 원맨아미형 캐릭터. 방어력 무시 데미지가 핵심이라 고디시트(페널티) 구간에서 특히 강력.

archetypes.name: 라피: 레드 후드 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 단일 타겟/광역 모두 강력한 원맨아미형 딜러. 버스트I 쿨감 역할도 겸할 수 있음. 프레임 드랍 시 성능이 급락하는 단점.

archetypes.name: 홍련: 흑영(SBS) 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 저페널티 구간 최강 화면 클리어형 캐릭터. 한 타겟을 맞히면 화면 전체가 정리되는 광역 전이 효과가 핵심.

archetypes.name: 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 60프레임 안정적으로 유지 가능하면 어떤 버스트I/II를 데려가도 스토리를 밀 수 있는 화력형 캐릭터.

archetypes.name: 안니스: 스타 솔로캐리
archetypes.note: 버스트I 혼자서 딜/버프/쿨감/버스트 게이지 생성을 모두 담당해 버스트II·III 티어에 구애받지 않고 캐리 가능.

archetypes.name: 민트카(민트+프리카)
archetypes.note: 강력한 버프 듀오. 다만 실드/1차 풀버스트 화력이 약해 두 캐릭터가 세트로 묶여야만 제 성능이 나오는 경직적인 조합. 버스트I로 안니스: 스파클링 서머를 쓰면 시너지가 배가됨.

archetypes.name: 엘마초(마스트: 로망틱 메이드+앵커: 이노센트 메이드)
archetypes.note: 무조건적인 강력한 버프 + 튼튼한 힐 + 재장전 속도 증가로 구 메타였던 블랑+누아르 조합을 완전히 대체함. 캠페인 보스 상대로 앵커의 HP 저장(스토리지) 효과와 궁합이 좋음.

archetypes.name: 티아+나가
archetypes.note: 미시리스 소속 스쿨걸 듀오. 딜러 궁합을 크게 타지 않아 어떤 버스트III를 데려가도 무난하게 작동. 버스트I이 한 명 더 필요하다는 게 유일한 제약.

archetypes.name: 크라운(+티아+나가 대체)
archetypes.note: 크라운은 '티아+나가' 아키타입의 상위호환이자 대체재입니다 — 같은 역할(버스트II 코어)을 더 잘 수행하므로, 크라운을 보유하고 있다면 이 조합에 티아+나가를 추가로 넣지 마세요. 특히 나가는 버스트II를 크라운이 담당하게 되면 자신의 버스트 스킬(쿨타임 20초, 크라운과 동일)이 실제로 발동할 타이밍을 얻지 못해 토템(1/2스킬 상시 효과만 남는 역할)으로 전환되는데, 이 경우 나가와의 궁합에만 의존하는 티아를 넣을 근거도 함께 사라집니다. 티아+나가는 크라운이 로스터에 없을 때만 대신 채택하는 조합입니다.

archetypes.name: 이자벨+아르카나 전기/철 보스전 코어
archetypes.note: 안니스: 스타, 신데렐라/신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 함께 전기 약점/철 약점 보스전에서 핵심 조합으로 꼽히는 페어.

archetypes.name: 나가는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브 전용
archetypes.note: 나가는 코어 데미지 증뎁이라 스킬뎀 위주인 스노우화이트/SBS 등과는 궁합이 나쁘고, 코어뎀 스케일링하는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 조합했을 때만 진가를 발휘함.

archetypes.name: 즈바이(트레저)+민트
archetypes.note: 즈바이 트레저의 약점(크리티컬 확률/피해 부족)을 민트의 버프가 정확히 보완해줘서 최상급 페어링으로 평가됨.

archetypes.name: 델타: 닌자시프+크라운
archetypes.note: 델타가 받는피해 증가 디버프를 걸어 크라운의 S2를 반복 발동시키는 연계.

archetypes.name: 택티컬 엠마+택티컬 은화
archetypes.note: 고정 데미지(참데미지) 버프를 주고받는 듀오. 혼자서는 약하지만 둘이 묶이면 베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드와 함께 PvP에서 순간 폭딜을 낼 수 있음.

archetypes.name: 베스갓의 바람 속성 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 방어 무시 데미지 때문에 바람 속성 캐릭터들이 특히 쉽게 저격당함(레이 아야나미: 잠정판, 홍련 등이 취약 사례로 언급).

archetypes.name: 불멸(인돔) 캐릭터군의 즉사기 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 즉사급 버스트 데미지를 막는 핵심 수단이 이 캐릭터들의 무적/불멸 효과. 이들을 상대하려면 지연발동 공격이나 무적 관통 수단이 필요.

archetypes.name: 2RL 인스턴트 누크(홍련+레드후드B1+트리나)
archetypes.note: 레드후드B1의 공격력 버프와 트리나의 버프를 홍련에게 몰아줘서 상대가 대응하기 전에 순삭시키는 PvP 초반 러시형 조합. RL(로켓런처) 무기가 2번 발사하면 버스트 게이지가 가득 차는 특성을 활용.

archetypes.name: 피뻥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+루주+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 23일 신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로/맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시 직후, 국내 니케 유튜버(스페란도)가 여러 영상에서 반복 소개한 PVP 즉발 폭딜 조합. 라플라스가 순간 폭딜을 내고 맥스웰의 최대체력 버프가 생존력을 보강하는 형태로 추정. 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 스킬작/오버로드 세부 구성은 추가 확인이 필요함(2026-07-31 기준).

archetypes.name: 풍라플/풍맥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 8월 시점 조사. 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로를 축으로 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉을 서브 파츠로 넣는 풍압 속성 보스전 조합. 다만 맥스웰의 실제 기여도(엄폐물 회복 버프가 나가+티아 조합과 상충한다는 지적 있음)에 대한 평가가 유튜버 간에 갈려 필수픽으로 단정하기는 이름. 이사카나로 맥스웰을 대체하는 조합도 대안으로 거론됨(출처: 스페란도).

archetypes.name: 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 대체 조합(마르차나: 마린 스터디)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 출시 신캐 마르차나: 마린 스터디를 기존 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 자리의 대체픽으로 활용하는 조합(출처: 김진서). 재장전 시 탄환 2배 + 공격력 대폭 증가 스킬 구조가 핵심으로 언급됨(출처: 고뇨).

archetypes.name: 오토팀(초심자용 밸런스 조합)
archetypes.note: 힐/공격버프/쿨감이 고루 섞인 무난한 자동전투용 조합. 베스티/라피 대신 신데렐라나 홍련: 흑영, 모더니아로 대체 가능하고 리터 대신 페퍼(쿨감은 없지만 강한 힐)나 D:킬러와이프/루주(기본공격 트리거 쿨감)로 대체 가능.

archetypes.name: 엘리시온 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 광역 화력(라피/베스티)에 헬름 트레저의 힐, 앵커의 HP 저장 버프가 더해진 자동전투 특화 조합.

archetypes.name: 미시리스 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 리터-티아-나가 '삼위일체' 코어에 나머지 2딜러는 스테이지별로 교체(아인/라플라스, 혹은 드레이크 트레저/퀀시: 에스케이프 퀸). 참고: 2026-07-31 기준 국내 유튜버(김진서)는 신규 유닛 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉이 미시리스 타워 콘텐츠 정상화의 핵심이라고 평가함 - 구성 개편 여부는 추가 확인 필요.

archetypes.name: 미러 컨테이너(전기) 신데렐라 하이퍼캐리

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapi
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very basic team for Campaign. Rapi provides high single target and AoE DPS, while Mod and Helm are used according to the situation. Since both of the Fire DPS are MG units, they can hunt down any rapture with ease because MG units can easily lock on to core. If you need AoE support, burst with Modernia, but otherwise just burst with HelmT to ensure the team lives through anything. If your Modernia is not well built, but your Rapi has great OL gear, you may sub her out for Naga. This way, you basically funnel all buffs into Rapi and allow her to showcase why she is the best unit in the game. This team is usable accross any element! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast or Naga if Siren is B1. Siren may be replaced by other B1-CDR units if HelmT is in the team for burst generation. Modernia can be replaced by Naga if you have a well invested Rapi.

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Solohood (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very strong contender for the easiest to use Campaign team for players who prefer bossing modes over others, and are not looking to invest into the likes of VestiTU for example. Red Hood's burst generation ensures that the team can get to next burst before Siren's cooldown time. Not just that, but the addition of HelmT as a B3 support means you can do a special combo for players looking to push into higher deficits. While for the first few bursts you would be following the usual pattern of RRH->RH->RRH.., you can break this pattern by bursting with Helm once to heal the team to full (especially useful against Bronchus (farter)), and then using RH-B1 with Rapi's B3 to deal devestating damage to the final boss of the stage. This ensures that the team doesn't die to chip damage and confirms the kill. Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Alice
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A fully built Alice is a beast for Fire-Weak campaign. She scales well with basically every buffer, but this specific combo of Alice paired with Rapi has everything: Burst Generation with Alice, Helm and Siren, AoE Damage with Rapi and Alice's pierce, Single Target Focus DPS with Alice piercing through shields even! A very strong team and probably the best if not the best if not for Vesti's AoE being so useful in later stages where clearing a few small mobs such as Volleyballs becomes a neccessity. HelmT can even be replaced with Red-Hood or Maid Mast for making use of ATK buffs to counter higher CP Deficits! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast for her reload and ATK buffs, or Red-Hood for her B1 stage. Siren may be replaced with any other B1-CDR if you do not have her yet. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asupi (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Asuka is a strong DPS for fire, especially for stages without any shielders. No shields = no one to stop Asuka's teammates from making use of Asuka's core damage bonus for fire allies. Even if there are shields, Asuka deals higher damage to them, making them break early allowing for faster wave clearing. Not to mention, she can even hit raptures through shields thanks to her pierce! Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Red Hood's B1 or Maid Mast. Make sure at least one burst gen assist unit is in the team before replacing Siren for another CDR. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asulice (Rapi as B1)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Well, we've seen enough about Rapi B3. It is now time to discuss Rapi as B1. Rapi doesn't buff a lot as B1, but she really doesn't need to considering the damage she dishes out. A manaul intensive Alice for burst generation gets all the assist she needs from Asuka and Rapi that she needs to ensure that the stage is cleared! Fire mains can try using this team to achieve high deficit clears for the leaderboards. With both main B3s and the B1 being core focused units (with the B3s having pierce as well), Naga can also assist this team well. ATK buffs and reload speed from Maid Mast also allow for heavily improved DPS. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Maid Mast, Naga or RH-B1. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Breeze-ing Through Campaign ft. SBLice (RRH CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] For Low deficit players, there is nothing better than a good SBS! And who better to pair her with than Alice! Alice provides the single target focus damage that SBS does not have while there is a large number of mobs on the screen. Meanwhile, SBS with elemental damage is simply.. lovely! 2+ years since her release, and she is still probably the best low deficit DPS to exist in Nikke, even with all the new tech we have with units like Rapi etc. But who says no to using Rapi? If you lack Siren, just use Rapi to cover all your bases for wind weak content! She will assist not only Alice in focus target DPS, but also SBS by doing chip damage to mobs. All is well and easy in low deficit as long as you have SBS. You may take advantage of Maid Mast's Distributed Damage and ATK buffs to further buff your Scarlet, provided that you are able to properly burst gen with Alice. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced by Maid Mast.

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Cindy & Ein (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team consists of Ein, who is a strong AoE mobber in Campaign especially at High Deficit thanks to her True Damage. Rapi: Red Hood is used as the other B3 because there is no other Electric B3 yet that can fill this role better (Red Hood & Alice come close). HelmTr is used to activate Crown's S2 and provide emergency heal on Burst if needed. Siren is used as CDR. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

Red Hood also offers fast Burst gen, much faster than HelmTr if needed because she can be spammed. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Cindy & Ein (Non-CDR Variant)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Rapipi & Ein (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team is one of the best Electric stage demolishers, featuring Ein's True Damage and reliable AoE clearing as well as Rapipi's insane AoE potential, HelmTr synergizes well with Ein's lack of Core Damage and supports the team with Burst Gen (which the other 4 units lack). She also triggers Crown's S2. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Zap-ping Through Campaign ft. Rapipi & Ein (CDR + RH Variant)

The difference is that Naga does not buff all kinds of damage but buffs Core Damage immensely. Both still trigger Crown's S2, however. Substitutions: - (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + Variant)

However, HelmTr can provide healing and insane single-target damage that, when timed properly, can change the tides of a battle, especially against Farters. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + RH Variant)

archetypes.name: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapilud (CDR + Variant)

Higher CP negates stat penalty. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Clash-ing Through Campaign ft. RRH & Maxwell (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Rapi: Red Hood funnel team that is slightly more balanced and flexible since RH can buff Maxwell's Burst and also B3 if needed. However, Rapipi will deal less damage. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

An invested Maxwell, paired with RH B1 buff and Naga's Core Damage can deal debilitating damage to an enemy. Substitutions: - (속성: Iron)

It’s balanced and well-rounded with heal, offensive, buffs. Substitutions: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade, Rapi: Red Hood can be replaced with: Cinderella, the better Scarlet. Huge wipe, strong DPS, and Blanc gives her everything she wants too (HP + Damage increase). Definitely a good alternative. Note that Dorothy is a Pilgrim so it’s not easy to roll her. N102 is your go-to when you don’t have any of the above Nikke, go N102. If you are missing Crown, you can use Tia.

archetypes.name: Old "God Team"
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] They used to be the most braindead team in Nikke until Blanc-Noir were released. This team has wipe, strong DPS, CDR, a shield that blocks most instant death attacks once in a while, and a nice passive heal from Rapunzel that doesn’t even require her Bursting. Rapunzel can even come in clutch with her revival Burst, saving your run from a disaster. Heavily out-classed by any other duos, but if your duos are not completely, you can go this route. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Manual Play with Lots of Clicking
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the traditional team pushing story. They have semi wipe with Privaty (mostly, just stun), boss killing with Alice (requires extremely high investment but she’s worth), and damage buffers with Maxwell + Liter + Privaty. Problem is, they require you to “aim” manually, and it’s not a good experience aiming those small flying Raptures from afar. Highly NOT recommended, just putting them here as a tribute to the past. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Vesgod Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Did I just say this is where most auto teams stop? Definitely not with this team. Vesti will Burst first, make her way to the boss stage then Rapi finishes it. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: T.T Stars Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Another version of Vesgod team which has a lot of heal but is vulnerable against one shot KO Raptures. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Updated version of old Alice Maxwell team, but this time you have super strong buffers which are Crown and Naga. You also replace Maxwell with Alice 2.0 - yeah she's named Milk. Worst part? Milk is even more difficult to play than Alice. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] To push at this level, not only you have to fully invest in these Nikkes, but also you have to rely on good Overload roll, and Elemental advantage. And of course, your own SKILLS! This is where you can brag among all other commanders how good you are, because you are pushing under a penalty that feels impossible. By the way, in this deficit, the enemy's defense will feel so high your Nikke deals very little damage, except Vesgod - she ignores all defense! In fact, if you don’t feel like running those teams below, you can just spam this team, it works. Example Gameplay: Youtube Video - Normal Stage Youtube Video - Base Defence Stage Youtube Video- Defence Stage Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team works on one concept - True damage funneling. It has zero defense which means either you kill enemies before they start dealing damage or you die. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: God Comp #3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Okay these teams will blow your mind, not only from how you craft them, but also you will say: Is that even possible? Key Point to Note: Red Hood is the Solo Burst I Unit, and DO NOT USE RAPI: The Hood here because she will be B1 version This team can deal with stages by relying on 2, or at maximum 3 full Bursts to pass a stage. When you use Red Hood as Burst 1 only, you have an insanely high amount of attack buffs over 10s, and you can even do it twice before she goes on cooldown. It allows you to bring 2 DPS, which will a lot of times be Modernia + Nikke that matches the “Weak Element” of the Stage. Ideally, the B3 choices depend on the stage, and aren’t as easy as - this stage is Wind Weak, so I will pick Vesti: Tactical Upgrade / Scarlet: Black Shadow Huh? Why is Vesti in Wind weak? It’s because there will be a time when you face so many Raptures at once that your SBS damage is splitted too much; it deals meme damage. When that time comes, please remember praying to Vesgod and she will answer. (1145F for example). You want to study the stage step by step and see what best helps you progress from one wave to the other wave, and what the next wave requires. At times, you might need to i-frame to dodge Remnant Raptures, or hold your Burst while your Modernia kills off Raptures outside of Burst. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the most commonly used team in Elysion tower. It has nice AoE + huge DPS from Rapi and Vesti, decent heal with Helm Treasure and very strong heal - tank for team with HP buff from Anchor. A very brain dead team, should put on auto and forget. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Missilis Best Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Thanks to Flora with her insane buffing, you can now ditch Tia and go for Flora treasure instead. And Laplace: UH also helps a lot on mob clearing. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Tetra Tribe Tower Team #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Tetra is special, they can form 2 different teams and each has their own advantage and disadvantage distinctively. This team is the original, featuring 2 ~ 3 heavy DPS, depending on stage. You want Anis against Electric weak stage, else just put Noir in her place and let Alice + Xlud cover the rest. This team lacks AoE power, so you may find yourself in a pickle against some stages. Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Tetra Tribe Tower Team #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] With the release of Crust and Bready, we can now run them together for a very decent and constant AoE blast. Bready requires Crust to trigger her Distribute Damage, else she will have no skill. Crust requires you to fast tap her 3 times from the very start to trigger her buff, else on auto she also has 0 skill. This team is such a hassle to play, but it's indeed strong. If you notice, this team has all 5 elements, so no ele shield can annoy you. Note that you may run Rapi as B1 here to unlock another slot for B3 DPS, because Rapi B1 still deals decent damage already. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: 2 RL Instant Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The bread and butter comp in PVP. You win by flashing your enemy before they can do anything. The combination of Red Hood B1 ATK buff and Trina B2 buffs will be enough for Scarlet to kill everything. The neat part? It's still 2 RL speed (after RL shoots 2 times, you fill your Burst gauge completely) Substitutions: -

archetypes.name: Pierce Heaven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When using Red Hood, save her B1 to be used with her B3 and Maid Mast’s Burst at 3 stacks once a fight. Burst Maid Mast every third burst (Crown → Crown → Mast). However, there will be situations where you need Crown to go third instead for her shield. When that happens, Burst Maid Mast at 2 stacks instead (Crown → Mast → Crown). Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Little Mermaid or Rapi: Red Hood or Liter. Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood, Milk: Blooming Bunny, Laplace (Treasure), or Raven. Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced with Naga or Privaty (Treasure) or Helm (Treasure) or Helm: Aquamarine. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Cinderella vs Ultra
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Cinderella just keeps winning and replaces Rapi: Red Hood in her funneling team. Switch Cinderella: Crystal Wave to Sniper mode for phase 1, and MG mode for phase 2. Burst Maid Mast with Cinderella as much as possible. However, there will be situations where you need Crown burst for her shield. Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Little Mermaid or Rapi: Red Hood. Cinderella: Crystal Wave may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood. Helm (Treasure) may be replaced with Snow White: Heavy Arms. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Artillery vs Moth
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A high investment, high reward team. Snow White needs highest final ATK than the rest of the team to make sure she gets Miranda (Treasure)’s Critical Rate buff. Make sure every Snow White nuke hits the core and 2 parts. Substitutions: Zwei (Treasure) may be replaced by Miranda (Treasure). Maxwell may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave if and only if Snow White still manages to get Miranda (Treasure)’s S2 Critical Rate buff. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Battle without your King
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A shielder is needed to survive the fight, which is the only reason Tia is here. archetypes.name: 2b mast wombo combo
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Old meta General comp for 2B. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: A2 clearing your screen
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Strong team for Fire weak Campaign. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Ultra wong
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A very solid team for Ultra A.I. Ada buffs more than Helm here and she provides decent heal enough that Red/Laplace will survive easily. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fishing with Ada
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Technically, Ada is as same as M.Mast, but she heals, and doesn't require odd gameplay (juggling between Crown burst and Mast burst) (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: One shot, one kill
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is very hilarious, because it ends the fight after 5 shots (or longer with immune from Noah or stun from Siren). Biscuit won't save you, but may be with Noise/Moran, you may have a chance

archetypes.name: Pew pew true damage
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team funnels a lot of ATK onto Ein and Ada. Ein also enjoys true damage buff from Ada too (which is 50% of her total damage). (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: AFK is a thing
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ada fixes the fundamental problem of Miranda: can't give 100% crit buff properly due to ATK diff between DPS. But with Ada, whoever burst ALWAYS has the highest ATK, thus gaining crit rate buff. So during Mihara burst, you afk Mihara. During Ada burst, you hold her burst till last second and release. Very fun team.

archetypes.name: Snow perma crit
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The idea is the same: Using Ada to fix Crit Rate buff landing. With this, during Snow burst, she always have Crit Rate buff, and making her burst deal juicy damage.

archetypes.name: Guillotine flex team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is built solely for Guillotine, because she requires her HP to be as low as possible, and she needs to do it as fast as possible too. Normally B2 spot will be reserved for Mast, but if you do not have Mast, or Mast is used on another team, then you can use Ade here instead. This team has nice DPS, decent CDR (Sakura S2 level needs to be as high as possible) and a power to protect you from debuff. Make sure that Moran pulls damage away from both Ade and Guillotine, otherwise Ade will fail to provide her ATK buff if her HP falls below 90%!

archetypes.name: Cool Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team for Ade: Agent Bunny. Fill in units to your liking.

archetypes.name: Wind Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Wind team with Ade. Popular flex choices can be Crust (for cleanse against annoying bosses like Thermite in Union Raids), or can usually be buffers like HelmT, or even off-burst DPS units like Mihara: Bonding Chain. Substitutions: Scarlet Black Shadow may be replaced by Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name). Asuka: Wille may be replaced by Alice. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Electric Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mari gets directly replaced here in the B2 slot as Ade takes over her job. Ade provides a new element option to the popular Cindy Electric team, and in general is a stronger option even against neutral elements. This is because she is able to buff non-pierce units better than Mari and Grave. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Iron Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Iron is her home element, and she definitely has fans here. Simple and easy to use her on this element, especially since Iron is home to many Pierce units. Substitutions: Red Hood may be replaced by Rapi: Red Hood, Eve or SnowWhite. Raven may also be replaced by them, but can also be replaced by Maxwell to pair alongside a SnowWhite. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fire Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While an invested Grave is the stronger option, a low invested Grave is worse than a Low invested Ade. With Siren taking over Burst gen issues in this MG laden comp, you only need to shoot the boss with this team, and be absolutely care-free. Substitutions: Rei Ayanami may be replaced by Alice or Asuka. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Scarlet Reload team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] OG reload team for Scarlet. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Alice, the Queen of Campaign DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] It does not matter who is with her, Alice will still probably carry the team in Campaign. Element does not matter, Alice is the best Campaign B3 in the game!

archetypes.name: Is That... Is That Uninvested Alice?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Guess what... Now, you can use Alice without too many investments thanks to Liberalio. Usually, Alice needs 10/x/10 and 2 Charge Speed OL to be usable, but Liberalio cuts this cost down to just... Burst Lv. 10 (if Liberalio's S1 is 10). This is a boon to new players. That said, we don't really recommend this team for late-game content, especially since SBS exists and invested Alice is still a recommendation. Substitutions: Crown/MastM can be replaced by Anchor: Innocent Maid. Other Reload Speed buffers also work, but do not use another B3 that might steal Liberalio's Charge Speed, including RRH B1.

archetypes.name: The SG Meta Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new meta SG comp, ready to compete against other teams for a top spot in Raids! B. Alice not only provides the basic necessities of healing and Ammo Support for this team, but she also provides the very crucially needed stack count up for Tove! Not only does B. Alice allow for a permanent uptime of Tove's S2 for all of the team, she also ensures that Leona gets to keep Tove's Burst Skill stacks as well. While this team still has its drawbacks, it awaits even stronger SG units to take it to an even higher level!

archetypes.name: Reload Heaven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we focus on overloading our units with maximum Reload Speed, allowing them to Fire to their heart's content. Both Rapi: Red Hood and Alice scale well with this. Crown is likely the better option here despite Mast's alliance with Anchor. This is not something you'd normally do in Solo Raid, but it might be something viable for Union Raid or Anomaly Interception, so keep that in mind! If you use Crown, then Anchor can be treated as an Off-Burst B2 or occasional B2. Substitutions: Crown instead of Mast: Romatic MaidLiter instead of Rapi: Red Hood

archetypes.name: Fully Auto Stage 7 - Kraken is down!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While we did indeed mention that Anchor’s fate is destined to be to take care of a drunk Mast, we have news for you. Insane QoL update alert! By far the best team yet for an easy Kraken daily run. This team is able to comfortably stage 6 or stage 7 Kraken provided your DPS are decently invested into. With above average investments, players should be able to get to stage 7 on full auto with this comp. Players may need doll investments to survive the QTE on full auto. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 2025. The year of Elysion! Ingrid stays cooking. The duo provides a new perspective for Elysion tower meta, and takes over the job of healing, Burst gen and buffing, all at once! Rapi: Red Hood insanely benefits from their buffs, and while the remaining B3 spot is quite weak in terms of pushing higher deficits, we still have solid options and even some synergy in Phantom! We finally have something solid for Elysion Tower, so start pushing that stage you have been stuck on for ages!

archetypes.name: Scarletto's Arc
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Two of the most common pairings for Scarlet in the Scar-Jack comp are Blanc and Anne: Miracle Fairy. Now, Anchor can join them. Instead of focusing on reviving and pressuring enemy adjustments, Anchor heals the team and boosts Scarlet's damage without feeding Jackal. Substitutions: Replace Laplace with Maiden:Ice Rose if you don't have treasure version

archetypes.name: H E A L I N G
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Two revives. 4-5 healers. 2RL with Jackal, 3RL with Mana. Do NOT let them Burst! A fast Burst means Helm can snipe out a jackal link. A slower Burst means you need to kill this absolute tank of a team! Substitutions: Replace Jackal with Mana if you want to save her for another team

archetypes.name: New Player team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Team for players who have just started out.

archetypes.name: Anis Dominates Tetra Tower!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Tetra Tower team features Anis: Star being buffed by SAnis & Velvet.

archetypes.name: If You Need Survivability + Heal
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Combine Damage Reduction + Heal/Max HP▲ for insane tanking potential. Can be used for Mobbing too.

archetypes.name: Iron-Weak Musical
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Iron-weak Bossing comp. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Nayuta & Anis's Concert I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A PvP team that features unkillable Nayuta + Anis Star, combined with PrivatyTr for Stun and AoE pressure.

archetypes.name: Nayuta & Anis's Concert II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A PvP team that features unkillable Nayuta + Anis Star, combined with HelmTr for single-target nuke and lifesteal.

archetypes.name: Anis & Blanc's Concert I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A PvP Attack team that features an undying Anis + an Indomitable B3 to breach some solid defense teams. Use FLEX slots to manipulate speed.

archetypes.name: Anis & Blanc's Concert II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant that makes Biscuit indomitable, guaranteeing Anis's survivability. Use FLEX slots to manipulate speed.

archetypes.name: Delayed Indom for Indom War
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Using Anis's Re-enter to intentionally delay Indomitability, making your Indomitable B3 more likely to win Indomitability War.

archetypes.name: Cindy's Slow Theatrical
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The ol' slow Cindy comp with Anis instead of Rumani.

archetypes.name: Best Anis PvP Team 1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Arena team (also works for CA) is a 2 RL comp (with Quantum on Anis, Helm, or Biscuit [or Anis + 1 of them]) that uses HelmTr's lifesteal + Nayuta's heal share to survive barrages of damage, Cindy to block SG attacks and ensure a full chain against Rosanna (who will kill HelmTr), and Biscuit to provide Anis with long periods of Immunity, allowing her to survive until enemy Indomitability ends. Nayuta + Anis + Cindy BA combine firepower to unleash devastating damage.Using Tempering or Vigor on HelmTr & Biscuit is recommended. Nayu must NOT be the second highest ATK in team to avoid being Rosanna-countered. Substitutions: Anis: Star can be P1 or P2. In P2, she procs Biscuit's immune slower or not at all, which can be good and bad. In P1, she is almost guaranteed to proc it.

archetypes.name: Best Anis PvP Team 2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features incredible oppressive stalling experience. It beats many teams (including Variant 1) and is one of the best teams for CA. High Charge Speed OL is recommended to prevent MoranTr from getting sniped by opposing HelmTr. Substitutions: BayTr can be replaced by Mana.

archetypes.name: Best Anis PvP Team 3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the best of the three but is very expensive (uses Biscuit). Usable for Rookie and SpA but may reduce viability of other comps in CA.

archetypes.name: Isabel Operates a Shotgun, Remember?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Isabel operates a Shotgun, so by law we are obliged to introduce this team. Tove increases Isabel's ATK and ATK SPD and supplies her with Max Ammo, allowing her to shoot more and harder. Dolla also grants small offensive buffs, but most importantly she is here for CDR. DrakeTr provides ATK buff to Isabel and herself.If you have ever thought about it, do NOT use BSoda here. We have also asked people to try with Leona and MastM instead of Dolla, and both reduce the team's damage against Electric-weak monsters at least.Unlike the other two teams featured in this guide, this team lacks healing, which can be a problem in some Raids. Substitutions: Dolla can be replaced with Helm: Aqua Marine or Leona. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Isabel and Scarlet Befriend Each Other
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A bossing team that matches 2 niche units with 2 other niche units. Does not steal DPS/supports from other already established teams. Scarlet benefits from Trina's skills and Arcana's lingering buffs, and Trina helps with burst gen and survivability. Liter is the best B1 CDR here, although she can be replaced by anyone, including Volume.Do note that this team is unideal for Trina + Scarlet. This is because Trina's Burst Skill is needed to activate her broken S2 effects. Sacrificing it every other rotation for Arcana's will reduce Scarlet's auto-attack damage measurably. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced with Volume. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Isabel Goes on Vacation With Cinderella
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A bossing team that revolves around Cinderella benefitting from Arcana's lingering buffs and quicker rotations. This team features 9-burst Cinderella accompanied by Rouge's, Arcana's, and Blanc's buffs/debuffs and healing. Blanc's Damage Taken scales well with Arcana + Isabel's already inflated ATK + ATK DMG. To carry this team to its greatest, learn how to manual Rouge for fast burst gen, which involves pre-reloading and pre-charging and a bunch of Max Ammo.Rouge also requires heavy manual gameplay in timing her CDR so that it triggers within Isabel's short 5s Full Burst. You will have to count, stop releasing Full Charge(s) before Full Burst, and make sure to land the 8th Full Charge only after Full Burst begins. Rouge's CDR has a small animation near her when triggered—pay a close attention! If this is not your fancy, avoid using this team (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Would've Been Electric Meta, But Lapluh Turned Out Wind
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of Lapluh's best teams for Wind-weak SR. This can catch up to if not match Mom-oriented teams. This team utilizes Arca-Isa's fast rotation to make Lapluh Burst more. Pre-charge + spam Trina for burst gen. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Rouge, but you need Max Ammo on Rouge and CDR preparation due to Full Charge mechanic. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Bunny with a fortunate mate
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Soda seems to have found a comfortable spot alongside Arcana in Iron-Weak. This matchup does not have survivability, but offers to deal more damage than this team would do with other currently available B2s. However, Nayuta may find use over Altcana if healing is needed. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Le old Shield Duo to survive Modernia laser
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A double shield cook that was used back in super early union raid days to survive against Modernia's cruel laser.Still relevant for players who are up against Modernia early on in Special Interception.

archetypes.name: Black is the New Wind
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A proper crit-focused team featuring Black and another Neutral/supportive B3 (SWHA/Helm/Ada, for example). Weaker than MirandaTr's version but used to save MirandaTr for Nayuta. Due to this team's lack of Crit DMG buff, Crit DMG OL lines are very impactful on both DPS. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Black, White, and Red
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team gives Black her most desired stats: guaranteed Crit and Damage Taken. The last B3 can be anything (DPS or support), but SSakura benefits best from Black. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: What's Better: Black Critting or a Black Crit Line?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team gives Black her most desired stats: guaranteed Crit and Damage Taken. We use SRosanna and SSakura because they benefit from Black's teamwide buff. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Power Idols
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Unlike MirandaTr's and ZweiTr's comps, this team doesn't have guaranteed crit, but it still delivers laudable damage! The B1-CDR can be anything. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Crown Pushing the Limits
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Well, we talked earlier that Asuka and Rei are both amazing buffers and even considered them the Anis: Sparkling Summer(es) of Fire Team. While Rei's kit does not fully synergize with Alice's playstyle, Asuka does, and her Core Damage boost is just insane. No, it's not better than Naga's, but you can save Naga for other teams. In this team, Crown + Privaty will ensure infinite ammo, while D:Wife and Liter will enable smooth rotation. Unless you have a good Alice, using Rei to buff Asuka is also a viable strategy. If minmaxing is not a concern, you can also use Naga instead of Privaty to spice things up! Substitutions: Liter => D:KW or Red Hood

archetypes.name: Bunny Power
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ammo Support is crucial to some units in this game, and the OG Bunny Duo of Blanc and Noir is the best way to mitigate it. Noir's ammo buffs suit all of the 3 units: Rei, Modernia, and especially Asuka. If you lack Max Ammo rolls, using Bunnies is a viable strat. Similar to S. Rosanna, Blanc's Damage Taken debuff is a separate undiluted multiplier and hence a major driver for Asuka's DPS. However, Blanc's shield is NOT individual. Substitutions: Modernia => Rei

archetypes.name: Indivilia Killer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Indivilia is one of the tougher Bosses out there, and a well invested asuka alice and rapi are best set to take her down easily (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Demolish Unprotected P1 Wind Unit
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A sample setup to quickly kill an unprotected Blanc, Noah, or Scarlet Black Shadow in the first spot. Only Asuka and Rapunzel are essential in the team. The rest are replaceable. Needs Elemental DMG OL to work.

archetypes.name: Asuka Blanc Variant
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic speedy Blanc + Red Hood (Burst 1) team. Lifesteal should increase her odds of winning in most 1v1 indomitability standoffs.

archetypes.name: Asuka x Rei Team Up Again
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The strongest no-Core Wind comp, featuring 2 EVA units. Liter Crown and Helm are the best supporters if you want to maximise Asuka and Rei’s damage. Since reload is quite irrelevant, you can Snow Whiteitch between Grave and Crown depending on the situation (Crown is still GOAT against A.I Kraken though). Rapi: Red Hood is the best if you are looking for just a single team comp and not for multiple teams. If Rei removes Wind-up, Rapi and Modernia might be the staple alongside her even on Raids where multiple teams are required.Both Raids or Wind-weak Campaign should fear this team. It can find itself being used outside Wind-weak Raids, but we will have to see how Rei practically performs first before giving you a 100% on that. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The Wind Terror
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Wind element is in business now that they have another mega DPS unit to use. In the end, it’s better to run Scarlet Black Shadow and Asuka Shikinami Langley: Wille together without Rei or even Alice to achieve the highest result against a Wind-weak Boss. This is the best team to use straight up for Wind Weak Bosses. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Tornado Bunnies
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Bunnies in 2025? Well they still have their use, especially in running braindead MG comps. Noir being a Wind unit helps her cause as well. This comp provides a lot of healing amount, a lot of ammo for Rapi and Asuka to shoot (due to Noir’s + Asuka’s anmo refund). Bread and butter team, use it when you are too lazy to even think. Machine Guns love ammo and make Noir a very happy relevant unit. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Off element Raid WAsuka
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Asuka: Wille can be used to high effect in off elemental situations even without Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name). Her damage taken down has often been used to help Elemental DPS to deal more damage.

archetypes.name: Common Bay Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has 2 layers of protection: Noise or Moran provides the first layer, then Bay soaks damage. It's a 3 RL team, making it very hard to kill even with 3 RL Scarlet. And 2 RL Scarlet will never be able to kill 3 RL Noise team. The last B3 can be up to your choice, which can be:- Anis: Sparkling Summer,- Scarlet: Black Shadow,- Scarlet. This one is actually interesting, due to the damage share effect, this whole team will turn into a Thornmail instead, with each nikke providing a 30% chance to trigger Scarlet's S2 on being hit as long as Bay is alive.

archetypes.name: Stall team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team relies on a huge amount of damage reduction and healing to tank through any type of DPS through to your face, while slowly builds up the damage dealt by 5 RL. It's super annoying, although Anne: Miracle Fairy will give them a hard time due to healing potency debuff.

archetypes.name: General Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Geneal team comp for Blanc and Noir.

archetypes.name: General Team for Blanc #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Another general team for using Blanc.

archetypes.name: Maid-for-Bready
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best team for Bready and probably what will be used in Water-weak Raids. This activates her On Hit route, which allows her to perform at a highly competitive level. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Sustain This Damage!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the only team possible that activates her DoT Route. It is decent but will be weaker than the Maid Duo. We can replace Rosanna: Chic Ocean with better DoT Buffer when the time comes. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Harvester is an Anomaly
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new generic Water-weak Bossing team. Harvester has mobs, and Bready has distributed damage to take care of them. This allows your other Water DPS units to freely shoot the Boss. This team can be used to full auto Stage 7 (except for the QTE), given that the other B3 you use is Helm-Treasure for Burst generation. Substitutions: Helm (treasure) can be replaced by Ludmilla: Winter Owner and Quency: Escape Queen (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Let Me Copegg
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A cope team for Bready, but it does work. If you are a fan of chubby Nikkes, this team is for you! You can even add similar waifus like Anis here, with Biscuit in the FLEX spot to buff Anis and Elegg! Adding Scarlet Black Shadow or Quency: Escape Queen in the other B3 spot is also a viable option. Keep in mind, however, that this is one of the weaker teams for Bready. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Mary the Water buffer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Strong team for Water raids. Substitutions: Dolla can replace D: Killer Wife (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire with XBrid
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the new (and better) mono-Fire team with XBrid, who significantly buffs the output of Rapi: Red Hood B1, DieselWS, and MiharaBC. Rei Ayanami must Burst first because DieselWS wants to Burst second (mandatory). Very useful in Union Raid. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire with XBrid & Crown
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The same Mono Fire team but with Crown instead of another Fire unit. Not as ideal but not everyone has Rei Ayanami due to its collab status. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: XBrid Punching a Hole in Alteisen's Body
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid deals good personal damage with invested gear and when paired with Tove (Treasure version, especially) and DrakeTr. She shines best against Fire-weak due to elemental advantage. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.HelmTr can be replaced by any B3. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: XBrid Buffing ATK-Reliant B3 in Miranda's Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid can be used as an alternative B2 to buff ATK-reliant units, such as MiharaBC, HelmTr, Liberalio, and DieselWS. She can also be used as an alternative if you lack better B2. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.

archetypes.name: XBrid in Campaign
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid doing her job in Campaign, a game mode who glorifies ATK buffs more than anything else. Substitutions: Feel free to use any B3.

archetypes.name: XBrid in Elysion Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid in Elysion Tower can replace AnchorM (in Maid Duo comp) or as a solo B2. Substitutions: For solo B2, you need to remove MastM. You can use MirandaTr + CDR, or use B1 CDR alongside 3 B3.

archetypes.name: XBrid Just Being a B2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid being the BiS or an alternative B2.

archetypes.name: Centi's White Adventure
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Centi's main use will be in Blanc vs Blanc mirror match-ups. The flex and B3 units decide the speed of the team, so fill according to your need! Centi's job will be to go against a similar speed team and force the enemy to burst faster! This way, your blanc team lives longer, and you win! Might need rng in Champs arena still ofc ): (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Safer Blanc
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] CentiTr makes Blanc teams without Biscuit safer to run, especially against TVesti.

archetypes.name: Safer Noah
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] CentiTr makes Noah teams without Biscuit safer to run, especially against TVesti.

archetypes.name: Safer Anything Else
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] CentiTr also makes everything else safer.

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Defense I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Noah to protect the team and Soda to stun enemies trying to counter Lapluh with Noah. While this team has counters, it can throw off inexperienced players. Substitutions: SWHA can be replaced by HelmTr.

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Offense I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Siren to stun enemy B1/B2/B3 (if possible depending on speed) and CentiTr to protect the team from early pressure. Substitutions: Trina can be replaced by any Clip RL, such as Rumani.

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Offense II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the same as Lapluh - PvP Offense I but uses MoranTr to stall instead of Siren to stun. Great against most Anis:S Blanc Biscuit teams. HelmTr + Liberalio are used to make Indom go to P5, who usually has a weaker Burst. Do not use this team if P5 has a strong Burst.

archetypes.name: So Much True Damage
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features 1 big spec: True DMG. Everyone except Moran in this team deals True Damage, and Frima+Takina will provide up to 230% True Damage buff, enough to make this team viable to a certain level. Still, by using this team, you agree that Moran won't be the one using Burst (aka CDR Totem). If your Moran Treasure is Phase 3, don't waste her like this, replace her with other subs or just replace Frima's Treasure. Substitutions: Moran Treasure Phase 3 can be replaced by either D:Killer Wife or Rouge. Even Volume is fine.Frima Treasure can be replaced by Ada Wong, but we assume you have Ada and boss doesn't require you to heal constantly (Frima Treasure heals a lot). (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Campaign Coper
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Just as we said in the review, Chisato can be used as a stage target sniper, assuming you can hit it. With around 40% Hit Rate (2 OL lines on average), she will have spread as small as normal AR, so you should be fine hitting mid to far enemies. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Moran (Treasure) or Rapi: Red Hood.

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature both Laplace Treasure and Ada Wong, which means this team is a 2 True DMG B3 Hypercarry comp. Ada Wong provides healing to B3 and buffs the B3 vigorously. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature both DPS Takina and Chisato as hypercarries. Maxwell and PrivatyTr provide the necessary buffs for them to perform. Substitutions: Maxwell and PrivatyTr can be replaced by other buffers/debuffers. ATK is preferred due to how much True Damage Takina can provide (despite downtime). Plus, Takina has no ATK buff.Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea III
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature 3 DPS, but the primary focuses are Chisato & Takina. XDiesel here serves as a debuffer who can make good use of Ada Wong, who also synergizes well with Chisato. Substitutions: Moran can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea IV
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team adopts the same idea but uses Takina as off-burst. Takina as off-burst only loses personal DPS (and a small Damage Taken), so using the Burst of another B2 doesn't seem like a bad idea, even more the case if your Takina isn't DPS-built. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Anti Moran & HelmTr
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is for SpA Attack only. Chisato can cripple Moran with True DMG when assisted by Blanc. Chisato can also block HelmTr's Burst (very common with Moran). Make sure Chisato is linked, and do not use B3 that give themselves a higher ATK that it surpasses Chisato's, such as Liberalio and potentially SWHA. Substitutions: You don't need to use Jackal or the B3 mentioned, but you should protect Chisato and/or ideally use Blanc to counter Damage Reduction. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea V
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the best Iron-weak SR True DMG comps featuring Ada buffing Chisato while dishing out modest damage as well as PrivatyTr buffing the whole team. Takina must be DPS-invested. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Zap Those Raptures with the Electric Girls
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team revolves around 2 heavy DPS but in the final damage charts, Cinderella will always be on top. All of these DPS also share the same trait: having an insane amount of innate ATK buff. This makes Liter inferior to Rouge, who is more ideal for buffing Cinderella. This team works great for both Bossing and Electric-Weak Campaign, provided you can spam properly with Ein and Rouge. Anis: Sparkling Summer’s presence is usually more important because she acts as a buffer for Cindy. Exia (Treasure)/Scarlet can be used as an Off-Burst damage dealer if supports like Anis: Sparkling Summer and Naga don’t fascinate you or are used elsewhere.A variant or two would work best for you depending on your investment; Mirror Container AI is a good place to test them out. Comps with Cindy, whether using Ein or Naga as the fifth unit, have proven to reach Stage 9. Both variants feature Anis: Sparkling Summer.For Electric-Weak Raids, usually Crown will join the strongest DPS (in this case, Cindy’s team). However, outside Electric-Weak Raids, you can choose to use Blanc so that Crown can support other teams with potentially more effective DPS. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: The best Electric bossing Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] - Substitutions: Crown may be replaced by Mari, Grave or Blanc. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Red Hood Buffer Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a comp that has recently set a new CP record for Crystal Chamber. The gameplay involves using Red Hood’s Burst B1 to line up with Anis: Sparkling Summer’s to avoid sabotaging her DPS (first with Cindy; second with Anis: Sparkling Summer; and then Anis: Sparkling Summer till the end of the battle). Red Hood’s Burst is also effective for Off-Burst DPS, and since Cindy also deals damage during her Off-Burst rotation, Cindy also benefits from it. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Off With Those Rapture Heads as an Off Burst DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] As we mentioned above, Cinderella is a great non Burst B3 DPS too. It's a very basic team with 2 piercers and one non Burst DPS. Works very impressively against Electric Weak stages. This team is for Campaign.

archetypes.name: HP Scaling Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Rouge is the best Buffer for Cinderella and 2B - 2 Nikkes who scale on HP. We also have 1 spare slot to put another Nikke here, which can be Modernia or Scarlet as Off-Burst DPS, or Noir to make Cinderella reload less.

archetypes.name: The Exia Coper for the Rougeless
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A tricky team to set up because Mast’s Burst Skill records the two units with the highest ATK in the Burst 2 Stage, while Cindy gains her conversion buff in Burst 3 Stage. For this team to work, then Cindy’s base ATK together with OL must be higher than Anis: Sparkling Summer’s. If you can achieve this, this team is quite good theoretically. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Fast Nuke @ 2 RL
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Cinderella's self damage is huge, enough that with Noise, she will kill everyone unless they have protection like Noah. The fun part is, even Rosanna can't save you.

archetypes.name: Beautiful Inheritance
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] SCindy and RRH are the best Iron DPS. Substitutions: Mast: Romantic Maid can be replaced by Privaty (Treasure). (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Beautiful Inheritance II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Campaign team strongest in Iron-weak/Fire-weak but can be used in Neutral. Unlike the Bossing variant that uses PrivT, Mast: Romantic Maid is more preferable for Mobbing. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Summer + Snow = Warmth
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Snow White tags along with SCindy to unleash destructive Pierce. One of the potential teams in Union Raid. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: MGs Team Up!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the most common SCindy's teams in Wind-weak Solo Raid. SCindy supplies burst gen for the team and benefits from Reload Speed and Damage Taken. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Annihilio Can Only Shudder
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team combines Liter's ATK▲ with SCindy's frontloaded damage as well as NeonVE's medium burst gen with SCindy's. Nayuta, Liter, and XLud make SCindy's burst gen trigger more frequently. XLud also gives Damage Taken. Good rotation has none of them reloading outside Full Burst to maximize burst gen. Don't forget to pre-reload SCindy as this team has no Reload Speed buff. NeonVE + SCindy should be able to abuse Liter's higher CDR cap. Substitutions: Ludmilla: Winter Owner can be replaced by Mihara: Bonding Chain for higher personal damage but less team damage. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Cleanse in Clutch
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has a highly situational niche, where Clay is able to cleanse debuffs off from our dps units so that they can function normally. This team is highly specialised for Bosses such as Thermite B or Heavy Metal, who are Wind Weak Bosses but have charge speed debuffs which cause ScarletBS to have much worse damage. Clay's Cleanse in this case helps her a lot since she can remove the debuff and allow Scarlet Black Shadow to function normally. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The King of all units, come to make Campaign easy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Crown for both Bossing or Campaign

archetypes.name: Fiery Land
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Fire team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.B1(CDR) can be Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, D:Killer Wife or Rapi: Red Hood.Alice or Rapi Red Hood can be replaced by Fire Asuka. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Wet Land
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Water team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.Rapi can be replaced by Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, or D:Killer Wife.B3 is usually Alice, Rapi, Asuka, or can be someone else as well depending on stage. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Thunderstorm Ahead
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Electric team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.Rapi can be replaced by Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, or D:Killer Wife.B3 is usually Alice, Cinderella, Anis: Sparkling Summer, Asuka, or can be someone else as well depending on stage. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Tornado Incoming
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Wind team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.Rapi can be replaced by Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, or D:Killer Wife. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Metal Crown Solid
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Iron team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.B1(CDR) can be Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, D:Killer Wife or Rapi: Red Hood.Rapi Red Hood can be replaced by Alice, Fire Asuka. Laplace Treasure or Maxwell. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: All-in on Alice, please!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Forget healing, Alice is the best DPS in town again (given that you are able to spam her ammo)! Infinite ammo on Alice allows her to bypass that Ammo OL requirement and focus on dealing deathly damage to her opponents! If you use Red Hood as B3, you have a double Pierce combo where D:KW will out perform Liter (if both are same investments). This team is for Campaign, and hence RedHood can be used as Solo B1 unit over Liter.

archetypes.name: The New God Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the basic structure for most Crown teams. Naga is the absolute BEST choice. Crown + Naga is BETTER than Tia + Naga when it comes to overall damage buffs!! The synergy is clear: Crown Bursts to provide shield to Naga, which activates Naga's Core damage buffs. In return, Naga heals Crown and activates her Attack Damage Buff. With crown's Skill 1 and Burst buffs in tow, they all combine to provide insane, never-seen-before damage buffs to teams! The advantages of being able to use Crown over Tia are simply too many!Rapunzel is a more comfortable/casual choice for when you need a safe and clutch revive with extra heals. One thing to keep in mind is Crown's placement slot. When everyone is full health, the healing effects are applied left to right (P1 to P5) . Hence, Crown should be placed in Position 1 so that when everyone is full health, she receives the heal from Naga/Rapunzel, and activates her skill 2 attack damage buff for us!

archetypes.name: Tyrant Class Rapture in sight!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team can prove to be really good for Raids and Bossing. The idea behind it is that any rapture Boss with a "Targets Highest ATK" mechanic will divide its damage dealt to us by 3. Alice, Scarlet Black Shadow and Crown take turns to receive damage. Not to mention, Crown has continuously renewing shields, and Alice has the ability to heal herself!

archetypes.name: Anti-Heavy Metal or Anti-Thermite
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Here Crust acts as either an alternate B2 buffer or as an Off-Burst B2, providing nearly permanent ▲30% caster's ATK as well as Hit Rate debuff cleanse. Since this Boss has a Core, cleansing the Hit Rate debuff will allow you to land Core shots more consistently, increasing damage dealt.If invested, you can choose to use Crust's Burst Skill to buff Scarlet Black Shadow's Burst Skill during her rotation. However, please do mock/check total damage before confirming as using Crown might still be better. If you don't use Scarlet Black Shadow or any other Distributed Damage Dealers, Crust can be fully relegated to the Off-Burst position. Substitutions: Liter can be used instead of Rapi: Red Hood.Grave can be used instead of Crown.Asuka: WIlle can be used over Alice. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Anti-Obelisk (Fire Weak)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Like Heavy Metal, Obelisk also debuffs your team's Hit Rate. Dispelling that debuff will allow your team to land shots more consistently against this Boss, which has a thin body. Since this UR Boss is normally Fire Weak, we use Fire DPS whenever possible. One variant of this team includes Rapi: Red Hood B1 with Asuka/Alice/Rei B3. The other variant has Liter/D: Killer Wife B1 with Rapi: Red Hood B3. Substitutions: Liter can be used instead of Rapi: Red Hood.Grave can be used instead of Crown.Rapi: Red Hood can be used over Asuka.Asuka or Rei Ayanami can be used over Alice. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Cleanse Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] There are plenty of Bosses that Crust can be used against. Bosses like Chatterbox pose a great threat to beginners who don't have access to shields or cannot kill missiles consistently, due to no access to Crown, Tia, or built Piercers. Crust, with her debuff cleansing, can allow your team to soak more damage without the fear of instant death due to debuff stacking. In this example, we use generic B1-B2-B3, but you know exactly what to do if you don't have some.Basically any Boss that has a debuff, Crust can be used to cleanse it so that your units deal damage normally! Substitutions: Liter can be used instead of Rapi: Red Hood.Grave,

archetypes.name: BREADing in Tetra Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we use Crust to activate Bready's skills and launch her to decimate Tetra Tower. While not optimal, Bready still has good AoE capabilities and single-target damage, especially with her massive built-in ATK buff. The FLEXES of this comp can be other B3, like Alice, Anis: Sparkling Summer, Ludmilla Winter Owner, or Noir — or if you fancy — another alternate in-Burst B2 like Blanc. Since Bready's Modes last 50 seconds, you can go 2~3 rotations without using Crust's Burst Skill.

archetypes.name: Anti-Crystal Chamber
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A copium team for those who can’t break its hitcount rock. In this example, we intentionally remove Crown because Crown is usually enough to kill the rock. Simply put, Crust here acts as either an Off-Burst B2 who allows you to take Crystal Chamber’s debuff route and dispel its debuff rather than taking the hitcount side. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Crust General
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Crust.

archetypes.name: Let the Snipers be Buff-eD
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A familiar team with D:Killer Wife instead of Liter. Here, D:Killer Wife buffs Alice considerably and still somewhat empowers Scarlet Black Shadow. Nevertheless, D:Killer Wife's buffs will be slightly diluted here.

archetypes.name: Elysion tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the new Elysion Tower flagship teams. D replaces Miranda

archetypes.name: Ninja Cope
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Delta acts on behalf of Helm as non burst. She provides better than Helm here (12% dmg taken) because Rapi is bloated with Attack Damage buff already and this team provides even more from Crown.

archetypes.name: 1 Queen + 1 Queen = 2 Queens
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best Fire team on the planet featuring Diesel as the secondary DPS to our queen Rapi: Red Hood. Diesel here buffs Rapi: Red Hood's damage through Damage Taken. MastM buffs Diesel's Crit Rate, which isn't yet diluted yet. This team requires Diesel to be played manually between Full Bursts (+ precharges) for burst gen. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: 2 Hyper DPS Not Enough? How About 3?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ever wonder how much damage a 3 Sustained DPS team deals? Wonder no more because that team is finally here: a good flex Neutral Solo Raid comp. This team features Nayuta as an ATK buffer and screen clearer and Liter as a massive ATK buffer (good for Diesel & Mihara). Diesel gives Damage Taken to Raven and Mihara, who have good off-burst damage.Diesel needs ~2× Max Ammo for burst gen here. Don't let her stacks expire. Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by other meta B2 as long as they provide ATK▲, such as Summer Rosanna (enemy respawn parts often), Bunny Ade, or XBrid. B2 with higher burst gen may be preferred over Nayuta even.

archetypes.name: IKUYO AZX!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Brid: Silent Track will be the new unit introduced this week, and will be one of the better pairs for the Fire team moving forward! She provides a healthy ATK buff, and against Fire-Weak bosses, extra Damage Taken debuffs. Both of these are adored by the three Fire Queens. Siren is important for burst generation, so there is no replacement for her. Note that, since we don't use Crown, Mihara is optimal here because she still gets buffs even as off-burst!Diesel may need 1-2× Max Ammo lines + be played manually to quick-shot for burst gen. Don't let her stacks expire. Substitutions: Mihara: Bonding Chain can be replaced by an off-burst buffer like MastM. Ideally, it's not HelmTr because Diesel already has too much ATK DMG. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Cinderella and Diesel Making Love
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Generic Neutral team that uses Cinderella instead of Raven or MiharaBC. HelmTr provides necessary burst gen and boosts team damage, whereas Nayuta gives ATK that pairs nicely with Diesel and helps clear projectiles. Liter is used for her high ATK buff that pairs well with Diesel, but you can also use Rouge. Substitutions: You can use other B1 CDR instead of Liter.You can also use other offense-buffing B2 instead of Nayuta, preferably one with ATK because Diesel loves one.You can replace HelmTr with an off-burst DPS or other supports like Ada Wong, who might actually be better than HelmTr because Diesel's ATK DMG is diluted.

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 1 - Generic
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Dorothy can go with different teams, one of them is definitely the bread and butter SG comp. Feature Tove (better be Treasure version), Bunny Soda because this team never has CDR. Bunnies provide more shooting time but will have less overall offensive buffs compared to some other supports. Substitutions: Bunny Soda can be replaced with Viper (Treasure) or Drake (Treasure), or even Neve if you have her extremely well built.

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 2 - Core hits
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Tia Naga can provide more buffs if there is a core to be hit. Substitutions: Bunny Soda can be replaced with Drake (Treasure)

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 3 - Drowning in Water
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If heals are not an issue, put Leona and Drake in. You will run this setup against Water weak, Iron weak and Wind weak. For Fire Weak and Electric weak, Doro won't be able to match high Ele Drake/Privaty though, but if you invest your Doro well, just accept the loss rather than using a mid Drake/Priv Substitutions: Drake (Treasure) or Bunny Soda can be replaced with Viper (Treasure). (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Funneling everything into Doropity
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team should bring the most out of Dorothy, so it's a funnel Doro team. It's a homewrecker because you will break 2 SR teams just to build this team. Ask yourself if it's worth first. Substitutions: Helm can be replaced with Ludmilla: Winter Owner.Crown can be replaced with Grave. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: 3 RL 3 SG
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] To run this team reliably, you must treasure both Tove and Bay (phase 1 is okay). It gives 3 SG an insane amount of ATK at 3 RL, which allows Soda to wipe most of Nikkes, then they will mow down whatever left with fast AS from Doro, Drake and Soda. Bay will help them heal + protect them from long nuke + prolong team's life by taking most of the damage. Pretty solid team in CA.

archetypes.name: Complimentary Train to Hell
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The ultimate SG team that competes with the Rouge Blanc variant. Grave boosts damage and accelerates rotations, whereas Soline gives CDR, deals supplemental damage, and provides a minor but potentially crucial heal. Substitutions: Leona can be used in place of Grave if well-invested and against Water-weak, and if she helps SGs reach effective range (wouldn't reach otherwise). BAde can be used in place of Grave but has less convenient burst gen.

archetypes.name: SG Team ft. DrakeT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Brilliant SG Team is a classic that can deal the most damage without using Blanc-Noir or Tia-Naga. Here, Drake can be used as Off-Burst as well as the Main Burst, depending on whether she is Phase 2 or Phase 3 Treasure.If a healer is needed, replace Viper Treasure with a healer (if it is Fire-Weak) or Drake/Soda: Twinkling Bunny (if it is Electric-Weak) or, better yet, change the team entirely and use our other recommended teams. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Another SG Team ft. DrakeT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team shines in Wind Weak and potentially Iron/Fire Weak. In this team, we run Noir as a DPS and as an ammo support to recharge the whole team's ammo (possibly to the point of infinite shooting) as well as boost their overall ATK. This team also comes with Damage Taken and unparalleled teamwide healing. Depending on the circumstances (i.e. whether Hit Rate is more important), Drake's or Noir's Burst Skill might be used. Substitutions: Guilty can replace Soda: Sparkling Bunny.

archetypes.name: Yet Another SG Team ft. DrakeT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team shines best against Iron Weak or Fire Weak. In this team, we use Tia Naga to overcharge Soda: Twinkling Bunny and Drake, allowing them to deal more damage. If they can consistently land Core shots (thanks to high Hit Rate▲ OL), their effectiveness will manifold.

archetypes.name: YET ANOTHER SG TEAM feat. DrakeT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team, similar to the previous team, uses Naga, but throws away Tia. This way, both Privaty: Unkind Maid and Naga are accommodated as Electric DPS, the team has healing, and now both Soda: Twinkling Bunny as well as Drake are seen gunning down the Boss! (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Not an SG Team ft. DrakeT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Syuen-sponsored section. Missilis Tower can benefit a lot from Drake’s Treasure since she has an SR 15 Doll and at least 2 Limit Breaks. Increasing Combat Power can allow us to beat stages in a much easier fashion. Substitutions: Laplace (Treasure) and Maxwell can replace Ein

archetypes.name: Run It Down ft. 5 SGs
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a team for ATK only. The idea behind this team is that you counter a defensive team without proper P1 protection, i.e. to undo their Burst Chain or simply just to kill them before they can retaliate. No, this team cannot reach Full Burst, but who needs that if the enemy is already dead? Alternatively, you can use Pepper/Viper or any other B1/B2 as deemed necessary if you do need Full Burst. Or use Makima if you counter SG teams alike (defending SG hits P5).You can slot in Anis: Sparkling Summer and Privaty: Unkind Maid and replace any of the SGs above if they are more invested. You can also use Laplace (Treasure) because she also hurts right off the bat, not to mention the splash. Ultimately, investments (and element counters) determine damage dealt, and CP is important for avoiding stat penalty from CP deficit. Do pay attention to Burst Gen (if you are planning to Full Burst with this team).

archetypes.name: 2RL - A Threat to be Reckoned With
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, but this time with new units running the show! Scarlet gets buffed by Trina, while Pepper softens the Highest ATK unit. Scarlet, Drake (Treasure), and Pepper will also provide immense frontline pressure, making this a very hard to deal with team without using important, high tier units.

archetypes.name: 3RL - Nuke Assist
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, where Drake (Treasure) is there to simply provide Burst Generation and slight buffs. Using Maiden or Maid-Priv as main B3 will allow them to deal insane damage once they reach full Burst thanks to Drake (Treasure)’s buffs to SGs.

archetypes.name: Wind-Weak SR Angle 1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Nothing too deep to analyze. A simple team that uses E.H. against Wind-weak Bosses effectively. She can be used alongside other meta Neutral Supports & DPS to form a solid team. Good against high-DEF bosses. Substitutions: XLudmilla can be replaced by Neutral Supports & DPS, such as MiharaBC. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Wind-Weak SR Angle 2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of the Siren + Bursting Velvet team that usually uses 3 supports. We replace 1 of them in hopes that E.H.'s personal damage can make up for Siren & Velvet's DPS loss. You can also use her as a replacement if you lack supports. Here, E.H. is generously ATK DMG-buffed by Siren, HelmTr, and PrivatyTr (or Crown off-burst if you use her). Substitutions: PrivatyTr or HelmTr can be replaced by Crown off-burst.
