Do not use Label B1 here because E.H. already has too much ATK buff. Ideally, the team has ≥1 burst gen support (spammable SR/RL, MG for Siren, or special kits). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The Boring SAnis Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A pretty simple team that all of us have seen on the leaderboards. Dorothy provides CDR, Anis: Sparkling Summer & Ein step on the DPS pedal, and Privaty provides the necessary Reload Speed buffs, as well as Ammo Reduction for Anis: Sparkling Summer. The B2s are the survivability supports to ensure the team stays alive. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: True Damage Team... Completed?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While we need more potent replacements over Rem and Dolla/Helm: Aquamarine for a better True Damage team, this can absolutely perform at a decent level! The downside is that Frima (Treasure) and Laplace need to have their Favorite Items, which are expensive time investments. Frima also needs Treasure Phase 3 to be a viable support, which can take up to 1.5 months to get.

archetypes.name: High Power Nuke (3RL)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Opponent running a slow team? This team can effectively counter it. The Blanc version of this team will fare well against most Noah-less teams. Defenders who are Taunters + Biscuit may also prove effective against this team.

archetypes.name: Indom, the Savior of DPS with Delayed AoE (3RL)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Water Main B3s like Emilia and Privaty can run into trouble when against this comp since Ein can hunt them down with nuke.

archetypes.name: RATATATA DPS Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An all-rounder with a FLEX spot that can be filled with any unit as required. Here, Elegg serves a DPS (and a support), and her goal is to shoot as much as possible. Insert Biscuit for cover repair & healing (note that Elegg is just a sitting duck if she doesn't use Burst Skill), or Scarlet/Guillotine for more damage, assuming that healing is unnecessary. Helm can be a good alternative too.

archetypes.name: Doro's Redemption Arc I (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Doro acts as our primary DPS, HelmTr as our secondary DPS, and SElegg as our off-burst support + DPS. HelmTr provides the necessary healing + burst gen.Only use against Water-weak. Good for Harvester AI because SElegg can continually kill the rocks and mobs, allowing the team to focus-fire on the boss's core all the time. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Doro's Redemption Arc II (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A Siren-and-Crown-less variant of the first team, featuring Liter and Grave. In this comp, Liter synergizes well with HelmTr and SElegg, providing ATK buff before their Burst Skill(s)—which amplifies their damage. Doro also gains extra Ammo and Pierce DMG from Grave and Liter. Grave and Liter also work together to achieve/abuse 8.2s CDR, allowing for a total of 15 Full Burst rotations.Only use against Water-weak. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: You Are Doroless (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If you don't have Doro, or your Doro is unbuilt, and your HelmTr and XLud are omega-strong, this team might be more effective for you. In this team, we don't have "carry DPS", but we stack buffs/debuffs from HelmTr, XLud, and SElegg to achieve greatness and higher total team damage. XLud provides Damage Taken, which amplifies the whole team's damage, including SElegg's. This team might only be effective against bosses with core due to XLud's kit being reliant on it. Substitutions: Siren and Crown can be replaced with Liter and Grave respectively; works the same way as with Doro's alternative team. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Basic Duo Teams
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Liter JKs or Liter Bunnies, both are decent comps where Emilia can easily fit in to. You can expect her to perform well in Campaign and Bosses in these teams. Liter and Naga/Noir provide ATK buffs that Emilia lacks, whereas Tia and Blanc provide separate damage multipliers that can boost her damage substantially! Naga and Blanc also provides heals in case she needs them. One thing to note about the Bunnies comp is their inherent lack of Burst gen, which is remedied by using Emilia as B3!

archetypes.name: Rem Synergy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] We believe that with heals and Buffs for RLs that Rem provides, Emilia and Rem will be able to make a great combo against Bosses, and maybe even Campaign...

archetypes.name: Oneshot, literally
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 2 RL Emilia which guarantees oneshot easily most team because Miranda allows Emilia Burst shot 100% crit. Require some good Crit Damage lines if you want to run Miranda solo, or just replace Centi with Helm Treasure version to fill the gap

archetypes.name: Two True DMG DPS Tag Together
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp features TEmma as in-burst B1 and TEunhwa as in-burst B2. It also features Siren as off-burst B1. TVesti and Ein are incredible True DMG DPS for Campaign because True DMG ignores DEF, which is handy for High Deficit. Unlike our usual mobbing comps, this team doesn't feature Crown, so there is no shield to protect the team (it is replaced by continuous heal; but beware of one-shots!). This team can also be used for Bossing, but targeted B3 based on element is likely a better option.We only recommend using this team in Campaign against Fire-weak and Electric-weak. You can replace Ein with LaplaceTr for Iron-weak, but her compatibility with the team is lower (due to her playstyle and kit). LaplaceTr is also not as good as Ein for mobbing. You can also replace Ein with Rapi: Red Hood, who is a good bruteforcer and should work for most elements (+ good synergy with Siren). If your Ein is weak, then Rapi: Red Hood might even edge her out in Electric-weak, but for Fire and Iron-weak? Rapi: Red Hood is the way. Make sure you manual TEunhwa or Ein for fast burst gen; Siren will "complement" through TEmma's and her own high attack speed. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced with D:Wife, Volume, Dolla, SHelm, Rouge, or Sakura. Beware of Rouge's placement.If in the future ShiftUp releases a broken True DMG DPS that overshadows others even in Neutral, consider replacing one of the B3 with her.

archetypes.name: Fire For Fire
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of the other comp but uses Rei as a team buffer instead. Since TEmma & TEunhwa are also Fire (same as Vesti), that means Rei can buff all of them. The effectiveness of this team depends on the investments (incl. dupes) of the trio. D:Wife is just an off-burst CDR. She can be swapped with any CDR, as long as they fit the team (preferably high-cap CDR who do not rely on Burst Skill for impact [SHelm is a fine choice, however]). DWife is used in this example because she is Fire (for exaggeration purposes only; she is not the best here). Substitutions: D:Wife can be replaced with Siren, Volume, Dolla, SHelm, Rouge, or Sakura. Beware of Rouge's placement. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Ultra Destroyer MK3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a premium Ultra Anomaly Interception destroyer comp focused around Rapi: Red Hood and Eve, providing them with immense amounts of ATK and CRT buffs (thanks to MastM). Eve provides the team with Damage Taken, increasing RRH's damage—our top DPS & carry—while MastM makes Eve's crit chance somewhat guaranteed, which significantly boosts her viability. Substitutions: You can replace Crown with Anchor: Innocent Maid in non-maxing content like Raids to better distribute your supports. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Ultra Destroyer MK3 V2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Now, if you don't have Siren, this team might be BiS for you (or not, because everything is investment-dependent and therefore account-dependent). This team utilizes Rapi: Red Hood's pretty good damage as B1, combined with Red Hood's and Eve's collective damage (+ MastM's crit rate), to decimate Electric targets with ease. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Old Iron Team Overhauled
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is similar to the modern Iron team, but instead of using an off-burst buffer like MastM, HelmTr, or SHelm, we insert Eve as an off-burst B3 for additional DPS and Damage Taken. Depending on the quality of her OL (and skill investments), her impact can be apparent or faint. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: General Eve Team 1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General Crit Buff Maid Team (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: General Eve Team 2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General Crit buff Crown team Substitutions: Helm (Treasure) can be replaced by Mast: Romantic MaidCrown can be replaced by Grave (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Miranda Shenanigans
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crit damage buff team with MirandaT, where Grave and Eve take advantage of Miranda's crit damage buffs (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: The True Damage Squad
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] It lacks CDR, yes. It also fixes your rotation to max 9 Full Burst. But it provides a lot of true damage buff to Laplace and Ein. For your record, this team gives 141.01% /170.84% true damage buff during Clay/Flora’s Burst.

archetypes.name: Crinum Purpureum
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Flora gives True DMG, so why not pair her with True DMG DPS? Substitutions: if the boss heavily favors Pierce, replace Chisato with Ada Wong to hyperbuff Laplace (Treasure). If you don't have Laplace (Treasure), you can swap in SWHA or Helm (Treasure). (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Guernsey Lily
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XDiesel loves ATK▲ and loathes ATK DMG▲. That's how this team was made. Give her as much ATK▲ as possible. Make sure to Burst FloraT with XDiesel. Also, Maxwell used to be the one in her spot. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Galanthus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Zwei loves being with Mint for the guaranteed crit, but SW already has built-in Crit Rate▲, so why not just save Mint to accompany Prika? FloraT here doesn't change the team's playstyle of holding SW's Burst. In fact, she gives the team a boost in survivability through Shield and Heal (for the DPS). Substitutions: Red Hood can be replaced by Maxwell. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by Siren or other CDR. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Hellebore Ice N’ Roses
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A meme team if you just want to see XMaiden stacking Max HP▲ so fast and dealing crazy damage. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Missilis Tower Buster I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best Missilis Tower after Lapluh, Mom, and Flora (Treasure) arrive. Substitutions: Any B3 can be replaced by Neon: Vision Eye or Quency: Escape Queen.

archetypes.name: Missilis Tower Buster II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best Missilis Tower if you don't have Lapluh or Mom. Naga can use Flora's Shield to give massive Core DMG▲ and ATK▲. Substitutions: Any B3 can be replaced by Neon: Vision Eye or Quency: Escape Queen.

archetypes.name: Missilis Tower Buster III
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Same idea as the other variants, but we want to Burst Trina with Lapluh instead for the extra Burst Skill DMG▲. Substitutions: Any B3 can be replaced by Neon: Vision Eye or Quency: Escape Queen.

archetypes.name: Lycoris Squamigera
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The regular Hypercarry RRH team, which used to consist of Anis: Star Crown RRH PrivT MastM. Now, just substitute FloraT for MastM. We put FloraT in between Anis: Star and RRH as they have the highest DPS. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Narcissus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crownless players have been crying about Ultra AI because Cover instantly breaks against it. Now, you can use FloraT. SCindy is in SR mode to Pierce and abuse Parts. AnchorM is to provide some Reload Speed and ATK▲. Substitutions: SCindy can be replaced by any B3, ideally Iron with Pierce, such as Red Hood. AnchorM can be replaced by any 20s or 40s B2 (except MastM). (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fritillaria Imperialis
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crown's and Flora's Shields can stack and block 2 attacks! Combine them together for some "easy" Campaign pushing, especially with True DMG DPS like TVesti!

archetypes.name: Dendrobium Orchid
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Give more ATK▲, so they can actually hurt Electric-weak Campaign Bosses. Also gives extra Shield and Heal. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Lycoris Sprengeri
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric has the best True DMG DPS, so pair them with the best True DMG support. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Amaryllis
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The "Crown-saving" Arcana-Isa-Cindy team featuring Flora providing Max HP▲ buff (enough for Cindy's Burst Skill even though it lasts 2s) and accelerating Cindy's Beautiful stacking. Flora has decent personal damage here. Ensure FloraT is not reloading outside Full Burst for burst gen. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Carnation
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the team ideas for Wind-weak Solo Raid. Substitutions: Moran can be swapped for Siren. Place Flora (Treasure) between Siren and AsukaW. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Gladiolus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use Flora (Treasure) to instantly activate Crown's S2 and provide buff for TVesti.

archetypes.name: Grave Steals Mari’s EVA friends
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team focuses on buffing Asuka and originally used Mari instead of Grave. Now, Grave is a better option here as she can benefit Asuka's and Rei's buff as well as providing the team with loads of Pierce DMG▲ and ATK DMG▲. If you somehow don't have built Alice, or if you are a fan of Evangelion, this team would excite you. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Campaign Shenanigans
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of high-deficit Campaign team fixated on buffing Asuka's and Alice's ATK as much as possible to negate stat penalty. Great for pushing Fire-Weak Campaign (Ch. 28-32). Red Hood as a B1 buffer will provide a significant ATK buff to the team (including Grave — remember, stat conversion buff since Red Hood provides caster’s ATK buff). Grave, Asuka, and Alice can then demolish enemies together with their endless Pierce capabilities and lifesteal. Substitutions: Crown can be used as an off-burst B2 buffer to provide ATK buff and Reload Speed when needed with occasional taunt but without shield. This does mean that Asuka will not enjoy her Elemental DMG buff. When using Crown, you may replace Asuka with Red Hood B3. Naga may be used over an off-burst Crown instead if Core Damage + some heals are more preferable.In stages that do not require CDR, you can ditch Liter/DWife/Rouge and run RH B1, together with Grave B2, and an off-burst Crown, Naga or Modernia. Of course, still using 2 Pierce DPS as the main B3s. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Keep Pressuring The Frontline @3RL
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A very niché attacking team to punish disorganized comps with as few expensive units as possible. Grave and Modernia's Full Burst Adjacency Strike apply strong frontline pressure. Rumani can serve as an additional/secondary tank with some self-heal and taunting, and her being B1 (unlike Centi or Anis) does not block Grave's B2 from being used, opening up positional flexibilities. Use an Off-Burst Centi to accelerate Burst or ClipSG to additionally pressure the enemy's backline.

archetypes.name: Water Showdown
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Possibly the strongest team for Harvester, but may depend on your investments! Previously, the strongest team was considered to be this same team but with Quency: Escape Queen over xGuillo. However, this team can be expected to give a similar performance, if not a better one. Ludmilla Winter Ownermilla is the major DPS for this Boss, so buffing her seems to be the correct play in order to get stage 7 on this Boss. However, keep in mind that, over time, you can get Quency:EQ’s dupes through wishlisting her. XGuillotine is a limited unit, so you will have to get her dupes right now if you want to aim for getting your title. This team can be considered BiS for Water Bosses with a Core, with the Quency:EQ version giving similar performance compared to this team. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: A Tower that refuses to get Meta DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An Elysion Tower team for xGuillotiine. xGuillotine takes her time to stack up, but will buff Phantom’s attacks during her own Burst! Substitutions: Diesel can be replaced with MarcianaPhantom can be replaced with Privaty

archetypes.name: Campaign Ease-of-Use General Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Helm (Treasure) allows for a lot of extra Burst generation that would otherwise not be present in most team comps in Campaign! She is a huge help and the best off Burst unit to use over Naga in the FLEX slot.

archetypes.name: Anomaly Interception General Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simply the solution to all Anomaly Interception Bosses. The B3 units are supposed to be element based DPS units.

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Redefining Burst generation in Elysion Tower, Helm (Treasure) really does it all! She can even act alongside Mast Anchor to provide immense Heal for the team as Rapi: Red Hood destroys the enemy raptures.

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Redefining Burst generation in Elysion Tower, Helm (Treasure) really does it all! She can even act alongside Mast Anchor to provide immense Heal for the team as Rapi: Red Hood destroys the enemy raptures.

archetypes.name: Can you get past it?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Thanks to Helm, we now can even push the Noise Noah XXX combo into 2 RL. This comp is just insane. It has stalls, it has a huge nuke, and it has huge follow-up attacks from Cinderella too.

archetypes.name: The ultimate stall
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The popular Nero stall is now immensely strengthened with helm, especially if you have charge speed on your RL units.

archetypes.name: True damage cope
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has so much Attack Damage buff for True Damage DPS. Frima can even heal too which is great. The problem is the damage output will look so bad you may ask yourself why you use this team. Still, if you are under high deficit against Mirror Container, this one may do. Or you can wait till you are at 30% deficit and try again.

archetypes.name: Jill Tia Naga
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Jill shoots hard per bullet. Jill can molest core, then why not giving her Core Damage buff? Hence we have this team. Also, you can replace Tia with Crown, and Liter with Siren just fine. Why though?

archetypes.name: Sustained Jill
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features Jill empowered by a Sustained DMG-focused buffer. In this team, Raven acts as a secondary DPS good for neutral, and Helm Treasure provides the team with the necessary burst gen. This team is logically only used as one of the bottom 3 teams in Electric SR. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: General BIS K Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Expected Raid team for K, where she will replace Ein. Ein is usually in this team comp instead of K due to the reload speed buffs and electric team buffs. However, with K being added and buffing both ExiaT and Summer Anis due to her ammo reduction effect, this team might be seen in upcoming electric raids. Substitutions: Siren and D: Killer Wife are good options for B1-CDR (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: No Pilgrim Electric Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic Electric Bossing Team for commanders who are not lucky enough to get Cinderella. Substitutions: Maiden: Ice Rose can be replaced by Ein, with Summer Anis going in the off-burst slot and Ein becoming main B3.Mari can be replaced with Crown, Grave, Blanc (with Rouge), or Summer Rosanna. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: The Electric Filler for Maids
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Maid Duo is notorious for electric raids since there is no B1 or B3 electric unit 'free' to fill in the B1 and B3 slots for this team. Rouge is the only electric B1-CDR unit, but she has to go with Cinderella and xMaiden with their own specific support structure. Ein and Summer Anis form a strong team together. Isabel needs Arcana and Scarlet needs Trina and there is no slot for another B2 unit. Hence, with K, we now have a new unit who is open to be used in the Maid team comp to fill in the electric unit requirement! (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Missilis Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Kilo fits in easily as a meta unit for Missilis tribe tower. We believe that she will be used over Laplace for wave-type stages, but Laplace may be able to compete against her Vs Bosses. While she does not benefit from any ATK buffs, she benefits from Tia's Attack Damage Buff.

archetypes.name: Kilo-ton
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simple team, very strong, but very expensive since it uses a lot of good units. Initially this team is 3RL, but with lvl7 Quantum cubes on 3 of the RL units, or with Jackal feed, this team can Burst as fast as 2RL. Noise buffs Kilo, while the others provide Burst gen. Kilo nukes the enemy fast.

archetypes.name: Tactical Label
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label can be used to deny Electric damage in the first 5 seconds. Using Label in Tactical, albeit not necessary, guarantees survival against fast Electric comps. This team utilizies Buff Overloading technique that makes Rosanna less likely to dispel Label's Damage Reduction.

archetypes.name: Tower of Fantasy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label in Elysion Tower is not the best choice, but she works. She can be deployed in the usual 1-1-2-CDR comp with SolineFT. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by DWife.TEunhwa can be replaced by XBrid (might be better).

archetypes.name: Imagined Feasibility
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The hypothetical scenario where Label gets used in Iron-weak SR in Team 5. Substitutions: Rouge can be replaced by other CDRs.BAde can be replaced by other offensive B2. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: How Much DR Is Desired?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Damage Reduction stacking to make sure your team take no damage against Blanc-buffed Electric DPS.

archetypes.name: Siren Hypercarry (No Crown)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Siren hypercarry comp with Crown freed for other teams (in Solo Raid). Substitutions: Label can be replaced by RH B1 or unpaired EmmaTU. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Idols Are My Hero!!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Idols grant ATK DMG▲ and Pierce DMG▲, which Lapluh's Beam loves. Their Max Ammo▲ also allows a 4× Max Ammo Lapluh to hit the optimal breakpoint. Make sure to Burst Lapluh second if she is the highest DPS in a Wind-weak content. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Forest Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Lapluh's best B2 partner is Trina, who immensely buffs her Burst Skill ATK DMG. Together with Mom's off-burst buffs and lingering buffs from Cindy's rotation, you can expect Lapluh to deal insane damage. Max Ammo OL is needed for faster Over Energy stacking. This team is played as Rouge-Mom-Cindy, then Rouge-Trina-Lapluh, with Lapluh Bursting second. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Hero's Mom
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A similar team without Trina. This team reduces Lapluh's DMG in favor of Mom's personal damage + an off-burst slot. If your Mom is heavily invested, you can go with this team. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The Indomitable Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: HelmTr and CentiTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.

archetypes.name: The Immune Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: Anis: Star and HelmTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.

archetypes.name: Bonk Master
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a random Campaign team example for Lapluh. She can be used as an AoE wiper with Pierce for killing enemies behind shield and cover. If invested with Max Ammo OL, she can stall for Over Energy, allowing her to nuke the stage target with the strongest Single-Target nuke in the game.

archetypes.name: Sword, Jellyfish, Octopus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Liberalio takes over the spot of Asuka: WILLE. The new and fastest team to clear Kraken (or stage 7 Kraken) (and at least till 3rd Anniversary) involves the Jellyfish buffing SBS and both of them dealing devestating damage to Kraken! Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by Crown. MastM can be replaced by Crown (recommended) or Helm Treasure (less recommended). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Windy Raid ft. 4 DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For Bossing, especially Solo and Union Raids, it is ideal to pair Scarlet: Black Shadow with Maid Mast. However, in this team, we also have 3 other DPS units that ShiftUp released just for dealing damage to Wind-weak enemies. Siren, Nayuta, and Liberalio all pair up with SBS smoothly and can end up dealing insane damage so much so that it becomes worth it to move Crown to another team! Saving Crown for another team = stonks! (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: It's Quite Windy Today
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For Solo Raids, it is looking very plausible that the Maid Duo will babysit the Liberalio + SBS. This is because SBS simply enjoys their Distributed Damage buffs a lot, and Liberalio would enjoy their ATK, Crit, and Reload Speed buffs. Volume is used for Crit synergy and for freeing other B1, but other B1 (except Rapi: Red Hood) also work. Overall, it is a very strong contender for Wind-weak Solo Raids (and Neutral). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Campaign Hurricane
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] These 2 DPS units, SBS and Liberalio, together provide solid performance on not just bossing, but also Campaign. Liberalio's nuke clears small mobs and paves the path for SBS to deal devestating damage to the remaining mobs. The more Liberalio kills, the more easily SBS can take down the remaining enemies. Together, they create a formidable team on any element, but will mostly be best for Wind-weak. This team may require critfishing on Liberalio's nuke to oneshot bosses (using MastM's 3-stack Burst in tandem with it is most advisable). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Unleash the Helm!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 2 RL Cinderella Nuke without Helm Treasure. Holy cow (or jellyfish)! Except you will need 4 Quantum Cube Lv. 7 on Rumani, Liberalio, Noah, and Centi. Substitutions: Changing Centi into Anis will allow you to skip putting Cube on Anis, reducing the requirement from 4 to 3 Quantum.

archetypes.name: Wind Blows Fire Burns
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] With 2 Quantum Cubes on Lib and Emilia, this team reaches 3 RL without any Charge Speed OL on Emilia or Lib (still needs S1 Lv. 10 from Emilia). Mihara dies, Burst or not doesn't matter. Nayuta will finish the rest, verily

archetypes.name: Tia Naga
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Liter.

archetypes.name: Grave
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Liter.

archetypes.name: Maid Duo
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Liter.

archetypes.name: Mari
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Liter.

archetypes.name: Blanc Noir
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Liter.

archetypes.name: The Best Electric Bossing Comp Aga-
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Best Electric Bossing Comp Against Water Without CP Penalty. Yes, that's right! Basically, in this comp, Rouge buffs Cinderella's and Maiden: Ice Rose's Max HP. Cinderella and Anis: Sparkling Summer alternate Burst until the Burst before the very end, where Rouge + Crown + Maiden: Ice Rose S1 + 12 MP unleash obliteration on the enemy. Maiden: Ice Rose will also buff Cinderella's, Anis: Sparkling Summer's, and Rouge's ELE DMG and ATK nearly the whole run. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Ein and Exia took away Crown
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In Raids, this team might pop up on Electric weak Bosses. The idea is to split the 4 mega DPS of Electric into 2 teams. One team, with Crown, gets Exia, Anis: Sparkling Summer and Ein. Exia Crown Ein Anis: Sparkling Summer Dolla/D: Killer Wife. The rest.. is this team. This team allows for funneling damage into Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose. With Ludmilla Winter Ownermilla’s Damage Taken debuff, we are offered a new type of buff multiplier, which helps Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose deal even more damage! (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Mana's new science funnel
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A typical team against Wind-weak stages. This is just a variation of the old Alice - Scarlet Black Shadow team. Mana can act here as a non-Burst B3 healer, or she can Burst herself too because her damage can pack quite a punch against Wind-weak enemies. Nevertheless, her kit excels against single targets so Bursting with her on mob stages may not be the most ideal. Noir and Sakura: Bloom in Summer are the top choices for FLEX. Do not use an SR or RL unit in FLEX spot. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Alice Funnel
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Let's just say you want a fixed team for Alice, and you don't have charge speed lines on Alice (like Rental Alice), what can you do? Well, good news. Mana can solve that issue!Mana not only provides pure healing to this team, but also provides Alice with enough Charge Speed to reach 100% (assuming 10/x/10 on Alice, as well as Mana skill 2). Hence, this allows us to get 4× Ammo, 4× ATK and 4× ELE on our Alice! Just imagine how many bullets she can Fire with Bastion Cube equipped, not to mention Liter and Grave also give Max Ammo. Furthermore, if an extra buffer is desired, Rei and Maxwell can boost Alice’s damage dealt. Or, you can just slap a second DPS like Asuka (which also buffs her). D:KW is also a good alternative to Liter as she can buff Alice’s Pierce Damage. Substitutions: D: Killer Wife can replace Liter

archetypes.name: Main B3 Mana
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Popular choice team for Wind weak raids. Substitutions: Red Hood B1 can replace Ludmilla: Winter Owner. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Electric Team Wind Activator
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Also a popular choice for Raids. She can heal and provide support in the form of being the Wind element unit to clear elemental QTEs in Solo Raids quite often. Substitutions: Anis: Sparkling Summer can replace Maiden: Ice Rose (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The Ultimate Stall
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team utilizes Damage Reduction to its maximum potential by combining units who can trigger Nero's passive and benefit from her "payback". In this 3 RL comp, Helm (Treasure)r, Rapunzel, and Mana continually heal the team while enjoying up to ~75% damage reduction buffs (dependent on investments, doll, and cube), whereas Moran and Nero tank for them. Nero can also gain ≥100% damage reduction here at maximum investments, meaning she will not take any damage at all for 10s after Full Burst! Not to mention, you are well-equipped with double revives, two Full Burst possibilities, charge speed bonus, and 10s lifesteal. That is some insane defense right there.Counterable by Scarlet stall teams or Snow Whiteift 2 RL teams involving Blanc + Rosanna to dispel Mana and counteract Damage Taken. Variants of this team include repositioning some units to let Rapunzel be the first B1 or to let Nero be the main tanker. Do note that Moran's Attract activates first, so she will be the one taunting primary attacks and Nero the secondary attacks as decoy (for Anis: Sparkling Summer's Ray, etc).

archetypes.name: Admire Captain's Fweeeet!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses MirandaTr's guaranteed crit to buff SMarci's S1 Nuke, together with Nayuta's and HelmTr's Burst Gen/ATK DMG (which SMarci lacks in buffing department) and SHelm's Damage Taken + CDR. Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by other B2 buffers, such as Ade: Agent Bunny. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by any off-burst CDR, but the team will be noticeably weaker. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Red Wolf's Fweeeet!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Same team but replaces HelmTr with Red Hood or other DPS, which may yield higher team damage despite SMarci's lower personal damage. Pay attention to the team's burst gen rate and ensure you bring at least 1 battery. Substitutions: Ade: Agent Bunny can be replaced by other B2 buffers, such as Nayuta, who has healing. Red Hood can be replaced by other DPS such as Milk: Blooming Bunny. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by any off-burst CDR, but the team will be noticeably weaker. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Snow White + Miranda Variation
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this version, Snow White Bursts first and easily gets her final extra 7th Burst off, compared to the rush you have to deal with in the Snow White-Yulha combo. Delaying the first Burst to get both Mari's and Dolla's ATK buffs is a valid strategy to min-max damage. S. Helm substitutes Dolla against Iron-Weak for even more damage! Mari and Helm provide enough Burst gen for the team. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: The Normal Pierce Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has everything: 2 strong DPS who scale stupidly hard with Mari's buffs, a CDR, a B2 buffer, and one more slot reserved for healing/protection or Off-Burst DPS/support. If you use Privaty and Dorothy instead of D here, you can have a budget Crown Naga team. Asuka may also fit in but will be less effective compared to the above mentioned units. It is also worth mentioning that Alice is a better fit with Crown and is even better fitted alongside her best buddy, Scarlet: Black Shadow, who needs her Charge Speed to drastically increase her already insane DPS. Hence, we might not see Alice together with Mari unless it is in Campaign and you do not have Crown or Tia-Naga.Since it is possible to use Mari as an Off-Burst buffer, you can also insert Crown here and use Crown's Burst Skill instead. This strategy might be effective against Ultra, where you need to reach Stage 4 before or right upon destroying the Boss's first Core (time gated).

archetypes.name: 3RL Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mari is used as a simple damage buffer for nukes. Scarlet or Rei can be replaced by any fast nuker DPS. Red Hood is used as a B1 unit to buff both Mari's and the nuker's AoE. The special assist from Mari comes when she uses her Burst Skill!

archetypes.name: El Macho Venciendo Kraken
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A lot of players will have an easier time with Kraken once Macho duos are released. It’s because although Kraken has a Core, Scarlet Black Shadow won’t have access to it half of the time, making Naga quite obsolete. In exchange, Mast will give Scarlet Black Shadow a huge Distributed Damage buff very early on, while preventing Alice losing Ammo too with the 109% reload speed. This comp is definitely the strongest Wind Weak comp, it doesn't matter if the Boss has a Core or not. Substitutions: Replace Anchor with Crown if you want to tank the shockwave (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Cingodrella
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric funneling comp but with new variation featuring duo Macho. The fun part of this comp is that all ATK buffs are caster’s ATK, so it is not affected by Cindy’s lower base ATK stat. Hence, their buffs to Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose will remain as effective. Depending on the Boss type, distance, and element, they may be able to compete with the popular Electric funneling comp, and you get more heals. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Rosy’s Revenge
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp is 3 RL, but Rosanna will be buffed with Mast’s Crit Rate and ATK, which makes it easier to confirm kills with Burst. A variation of Scarlet - Anne: Miracle Fairy - Rosanna comp without healing/reviving.

archetypes.name: Triple Moms? No, Quadruple.
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Weaker than FloraT's and Crown's version, but if you use both of them somewhere else, Mom or Nayuta is the next best choice. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Cheap 2RL Siren + Lib Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The perfect 100% burst gen 2RL Attack team without too many meta units. Note that Liberalio's burst gen is reduced against decoys and shielded P5.

archetypes.name: Crown Fire Team ft. Rapipi & Mihara
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of Mihara’s best teams for Non-Core Fire. This team has healing, high burst generation, and continuous single-target damage that's admirable against targets without core. Mihara also bursts second, which is her optimal rotation. Stable and reliable, although it might be outshone in core environments. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire ft. Grave (No Core)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Mihara: Bonding Chain acts as an off-burst character that deals continuous damage without having to do anything. Against single targets, her off-burst damage surpasses Modernia's. However, you should use her Burst Skill at least once toward the end for some extra damage out of her DoT. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire ft. Grave + Modernia (No Core)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Old variant uses Rei Ayanami instead of Mihara: Bonding Chain, better for some players. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire ft. Rapipi B1 (No Core)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Mihara: Bonding ChainBC either bursts first or second (your choice; please test which one deals more damage for you and your investments) and is the main damage dealer, buffed by Crown/Grave, Rapi: Red Hood, and Rei Ayanami. They are also all Fire units, which benefit from the compounding effect they apply to one another. Substitutions: Crown can be replaced by Grave. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An alternative Fire Team against core enemies for players without a built Alice. This team revolves around boosting the team's Core Damage and buff inflation in general. Asuka can be hot-swappable with Alice, though it's less optimal in equal investments. Substitutions: Asuka-Shikinami-Langley can be replaced by Alice. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is similar to BiS non-core team, which uses HelmTr, but replaces her with Naga/Mast Maid, which may potentially be better against targets with core. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) III
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team doesn't have any healing and exchanges it for more damage. Mast Maid provides the team with increased ATK, CRTs, and Reload Speed. She also synergizes with Siren. Do note that you want to only Burst with her at either 2 or 3 stacks of Drunken. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) IV
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Rapi: Red Hood B1 and Mihara: Bonding Chain Off-Burst as additional damage dealers. No Naga or Helm Treasure is used, which might be better or worse for you depending on your investments. Substitutions: Rei Ayanami can be replaced with Alice. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Missilis Torturer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While not being one of the best mobbing units, Mihara: Bonding Chain can make for a decent Missilis Tower team. This team consists of a lot of ATK buffs that Mihara: Bonding Chain wants and balances out the team's lack of high RoF unit with Mihara: Bonding Chain's MG, which is great for neutralizing Glasses.

archetypes.name: Pilgrim Tormenter
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An alternative team for Pilgrim Tower against bosses revolving around Siren and MG users. The FLEX slot can be a damage dealer (like Modernia or Scarlet), a healer (Rapunzel), or a buffer (Red Hood B1).

archetypes.name: Banish the SGs
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An Attacking team focused around shutting down SG teams (although Makima does that better). In this team, Mihara: Bonding Chain is sacrificed to fill up Burst Gen instantly with Rosanna, starting up the burst chain. Soda: Twinkling Bunny can be replaced with Noir. Counterable by opposing Rosanna (who also benefits from Mihara: Bonding Chain's death). Anne: Miracle Fairy for reviving (ideally Mihara: Bonding Chain to abuse stronger DoT from personal damage buffs) or Blanc for stalling. Substitutions: Soda: Twinkling Bunny can be replaced by Noir, Anne: Miracle Fairy can be replaced by Blanc.

archetypes.name: One-Night-Stand Makima
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Similarly, this team is a little more developed for Makima havers, focusing on sacrificing Mihara: Bonding Chain and letting Makima stall for 7s as Mihara: Bonding Chain's DoT cripples the enemy one by one. Also potentially strong against glass-cannon wipers. Biscuit can be added for extra stalling, but she must stay alive (and Makima must be attacked). Mihara: Bonding Chain is investment and dupe dependent. Substitutions: Add Biscuit if more stall needed over Soda or Drake.

archetypes.name: Frontal Point
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] When P1 is the source of chaos, we place Mihara: Bonding Chain in P1 to die. Any units after Mihara: Bonding Chain are free to select and up to your discretion. The units in example are just placeholders. Do note that Mihara: Bonding Chain wants to die here, and indom should go to someone else but her.

archetypes.name: Anti-Wiping Countermeasure
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A slow team engineered to "survive with as much HP as possible". We stake our survival on Anis: Sparkling Summer/Moran tanking wipes and lifestealing/sustaining and letting Mihara: Bonding Chain's retaliative DoT handle the rest. Must be used against wipers or SGs, and Mihara: Bonding Chain must die. Substitutions: Anis: Sparkling Summer can be replaced by Helm or Maiden: Ice Rose.

archetypes.name: Indoming Our Way Out of Here
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, we use Mihara: Bonding Chain as a gradual AoE wiper that isn't directly countered by Noah, compensating for Scarlet's weakness. We want her to die in this team, so the ideal development would be that she dies from a wipe and Scarlet gets indom-ed (hence stalling for the team).

archetypes.name: Stall the Hell Out of the Enemies
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, the main focus is to kill Mihara: Bonding Chain early on and just surviving/stalling until her debuff slowly kills the enemies. You can choose to revive her so she can benefit from offensive buffs, either immediately with Mana or with Rapunzel in the second rotation.Remember, her off-burst damage is plenty good already! But, you can also remove Helm Treasure/Quiry/Mana and avoid placing B3 to her left if you want Mihara: Bonding Chain to Burst for more damage. Finally, you can place Mihara: Bonding Chain in P1 or P5 depending on whether you're attacking/defending and the team setups (read more: PvP targeting - https://www.prydwen.gg/nikke/guides/pvp-mechanics/) and flip this team accordingly. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced by Quiry, Rapunzel can be replaced by Mana.

archetypes.name: Rise from the Dead
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Did we mention earlier that Mihara: Bonding Chain's buffs deactivate when she is dead? So, why not revive her instead and let her enjoy that juicy Sustained DMG▲ buff (and Burst Skill DMG if desired)? That's why we are introducing "the revival team". In this team, we kill Mihara: Bonding ChainBC and revive her with Mana and Rapu, and then use her B3 (because now enemies have 20 stacks of Ensnaring Chains, and we want to turn those into Dragging Chains!). In this example, we add Blanc to push this team further with Indomitability. You can use Noah if you want, but she might taunt hitters away, and problem ensues when Mihara: Bonding Chain doesn't die fast enough.Do note when using Mana: she is B3 and that means Mihara: Bonding Chain, if placed to her right, will not use her Burst Skill. However, this allows for creative positioning and usage of other Burst Skills if desired. Rapunzel is B1, so she herself does not impede her Burst Skill usage. Others might, though.Drake Treasure and Noir/Pepper are just placeholders that can be replaced by any units for faster or slower generation (please let Mihara: Bonding Chain die first and get revived before she gets indom-ed, otherwise no max stack debuffs on enemies). Faster is not always better. Substitutions: Rapunzel can be replaced with Mana. Drake-Treasure, Noir can be replaced by any unit for burst generation.

archetypes.name: Rise from the Dead (Adaptive Speed)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The same team as “Rise from the Dead” but with adaptive speed. This team is around ~3.5 RL to 4 RL depending on Charge Speed, but it can speed up to ~2 RL to 2.5 RL and even ~1.5 RL with a bug that we cannot currently explain (ref: https://youtu.be/PUWebkRXrMM). This is thanks to Rosanna’s Burst Gen Instant Fill from deaths of enemy or allied units. In this case, since we want Mihara: Bonding Chain to die anyway (she’s going to be useless if she doesn’t die before Full Burst), we can just pair Rosanna with her. With Rosanna, this team can go faster/slower depending on how fast the enemy kills Mihara: Bonding Chain. There is no too fast (well, unlikely)! Substitutions: Mana can be replaced with Rapunzel, although Mana is better.

archetypes.name: Fire Team With Water
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a mono-Fire team with B1 Water CDR and a B2 CDR, probably useful for beginners who have trouble composing a suitable team for Water Weak, Fire Weak, Wind Weak or Iron Weak Solo Raids. Rapi: Red Hood can be substituted in as a superior B3 to any one of the 3 Fire units. Dolla and Helm: Aquamarine usually have less optimal CDR, but with Milk providing an extra push, they now have a competitive CDR rotation for this team. Alternatively, use Grave or something like Rapi: Red Hood as B3 for more offense. Substitutions: Rapi: Red Hood can replace Asuka.Rei Ayanami can be replaced by Alice.Helm: Aqua Marine can be replaced by Dolla.Helm: Aqua Marine can be replaced by Grave.

archetypes.name: SG Team But With CDR
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, we utilize extended Full Burst + Milk (Treasure) to speed up SG team's rotation a bit. Milk, in the Off-Burst position, can buff the team's DPS periodically. Despite that, the acceleration is negligible and would instead cost damage due to losing 1 DPS/semi-DPS. However, since SG team is consistently outputting DPS, Milk’s ATK buff is very relevant for them. Not only that, but she can also provide the option of Bursting with her once for healing the team if needed. Not the best of teams, but definitely a strong idea.

archetypes.name: Heal More, Stall Longer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Milk's lifesteal + HP potency to allow the team to survive longer. She synergizes well with B2 and B3 who fortify the team. Make sure to use Helm (Treasure)r's B3 for insane lifesteal capabilities. Other stall ideas where more healers such as Maid Anchor, Trina are used may also net positive results.

archetypes.name: Simple 3RL Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Lifesteal Anis: Sparkling Summer is insane, because she hits 2 targets with S2 + her auto attack alone making her dishing out tons of paper damage. Those damages will heal her back a lot even with just a moderate amount of lifesteal. Noted that if she hits Immune Nikke, she will heal 0. Noah can be replaced with Bay but then you need Emilia instead of Laplace/Maiden: Ice Rose.

archetypes.name: Iron Golems
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A fun iron only team. Timed reloads can allow Milk to take advantage of Liter's ammo buffs. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Siren. HelmT can be replaced by Summer Helm. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Ammo Problem? What Ammo Problem?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If you are running low on Ammo OL lines, it is probably best to run Milk in a team where she doesn't lose ammo at all when she shoots. The Maid team is also ideal for bosses with no core, so you may use Raven alongside her to maximise damage in a single team. This can also save Rapi for Fire hits in Union Raids. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Pierce is in Business
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] By timing Milk's embarrasment to activate after SnowWhite bursts starts, we can always confirm SnowWhite to get Miranda's 100% crit buff, provided there is no major investment difference between both of them Substitutions: Grave can be replaced by Mari on a boss with Core, as well as Ade: Agent Bunny. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Tetra Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Just your new Tetra Tower team. Milk can perform at a very high level here, and can allow you to push higher CP deficits. Substitutions: Summer Anis is also a valid option over xLudmilla or Alice.

archetypes.name: Bunny? Bunnies!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] What better way to make it more fun, than to add even more bunnies! Substitutions: Ludmilla: Winter Owner and Anis: Sparkling Summer are good replacements for Alice.

archetypes.name: Union Raid Pierce Mayhem
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] We can see this team being optimal for Union Raids where pierce is prevalent. Raven may be used over Red Hood if there is no permanently available pierce spots. Substitutions: Raven can replace Red Hood. MirandaT, Siren or Liter can replace RapiRH in B1. Grave, Ade or Mari may replace Crown, and HelmT may replace Summer Helm. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Intercontinental Ballistic Missile
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is an upgrade to the existing Snow White team. Standard rotation includes SW Bursting first and holding it till the next rotation, only releasing her nukes in even rotations together with Maxwell to utilize Mint's buffs. Substitutions: SHelm can be replaced by any B1 CDR that is not ramping-type. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Happy Bomb Friends
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is very straightforward: Using 3 RL to delete everything onscreen, while having a lot of buffs to support them doing so. Mi-ka's buffs are more suitable for RL in campaign than Snow White Heavy Arm but you can replace Neon with SWHA if you like Substitutions: Neon can be replaced by Snow White Heavy Arm

archetypes.name: We are Electric
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team buffs 2 strongest RL in the game - Lap... nah those are Neon and Cinderella. The upside of this team is: It doesn't cost Crown, but the downside is - the explosion buff is actually kind of scam. Still, the other buffs are definitely strong enough to make this team work. You can replace Cinderella with Liberalio to create a full funnel Neon team instead, and putting Cinderella back with Isabel-Arcana Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by Liberalio (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Cry Mint a river
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The water funneling version of Mint team. You pour everything onto SWHA or Dorothy: Serenity (shouldn't, she has her SG team), and a random B3 buffer like Ada, Maxwell Substitutions: Zwei treasure can be replaced by Miranda treasure but it will be worse significantly (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: My mintshake brings all the boys to the yard
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Damn right, she's better than you! Anyway, this team behaves the same as Water weak or Iron weaker version: abusing the perma crit and funneling everything onto 1 hypercarry Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by any B1 CDR that is not ramping-type. PrivatyTr can replace Ada if she is available. Maxwell is preferred over Ada if you can live without Ada's healing. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Beautiful Performance
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is more of a Museum team rather than a Solo Raid team, although you can use it in Solo Raid if you lack other units. It utilizes ZweiTr's lingering Crit buffs and combines them with Liter's huge ATK to boost Cindy's Burst Skill. The rotations follow ZweiTr-Mint-SWHA and Liter-Mint-Cindy in a tight tempo, requiring pre-charges to maximize rotation speed. This will allow you to get 14 Full Bursts. You also need to pre-charge Mint and release Full Charge after she Bursts but before Cindy Bursts, so her S1 buffs her. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Technical Ravenry
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a team which has both DPS enjoying the best of Mint's buffs. Raven deals sustained DoT damage, which means even in her off-burst, she is dealing devastating damage. Hence, if you burst with Mint's Singing state alongside BMilk, Raven loses minimal damage! Substitutions: Milk: Blooming Bunny can be replaced by Red Hood. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Tetra Idols
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Idol version for Tetra tower. They are very easy to use and buffing 2 Piercers by a lot. The fun part is, this team has 4/5 elements, so only against Wind-weak stage with elemental shield, you need to swap team

archetypes.name: The SW Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is Miranda’s statement team. In this team, we focus on buffing Snow White's and Maxwell's personal damage through Burst Skill and guaranteeing Snow White's Burst Shot 24/7. You can recruit Crown, Grave, or any other relevant units to play the B2 position. You may use Helm (Treasure) or Helm over Maxwell if the team requires healing to survive. Helm: Aquamarine or Mari are also options if you want to funnel all the damage in Snow White’s favour. Substitutions: Helm (Treasure) can replace Maxwell.Helm: Aquamarine can replace Maxwell.Mari Makinami Illustrious can replace Maxwell. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fire Away
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Kisenix likes the Fire Team, so here is a Fire Team to showcase her "buffing 2 random DPS" capability. In this comp, we give Asuka and Rapi: Red Hood as much ATK and CRT DMG as possible. Asuka can also buff Miranda's Core damage. Rei can also be subbed in to give Miranda more ATK, as an in-Burst B3 or as an Off-Burst acting like Maxwell. Substitutions: Rei Ayanami can replace Asuka (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fire Team Again with Off-Burst CDR
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we use a more impactful B2's Burst Skill and instead relegate our CDR into the Off-Burst position. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: General Team ft. MirandaT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the general team build for Miranda teams. The flex spot needs to be a B2 unit if D:Wife is being used as the CDR for the team. Substitutions: D: Killer Wife can replace Helm: Aqua Marine.Dolla can replace Helm: Aqua Marine. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Elysions's sole proper buffer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A team for Elysion Tower when player does not have Maid Duo Substitutions: Privaty: Unkind Maid can replace Maiden: Ice Rose.

archetypes.name: TOS = Time to One Shot
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we play it crazy by using as many buffers as possible (completely unnecessary; for demonstration purposes only) and pair Emilia together with Red Hood B1, Helm (Treasure)r Off-Burst, and Miranda Off-Burst. This grants her insane ATK buff, ATK DMG, and CRT DMG + guaranteed crit that will surely demolish any un-immuned/indomed enemies. For a more realistic example, you can use Noah Biscuit Emilia RedHood Miranda instead for increased survivability, saving Helm (Treasure)r for other teams.

archetypes.name: Relatively Poor TOS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is 3 RL, sure it’s slower but you can save Red Hood for other teams compared to the traditional Emilia-Red Hood 3 RL ICBM. You will need Quantum Cube lv 7 on Emilia and either Biscuit/Rapunzel. With the 100% crit shot + Blanc debuff, we’re pretty sure they either go Noah here or just die. If your Emilia also has 40% ATK, can replace Blanc with Bay.

archetypes.name: Modernia's New Friend
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Modernia gets buffed by Blanc noir decently, while Rei buffs her even more! (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Modernia - Rapture Queen
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Strong general team for Campaign. Substitutions: Tia can replace Crown if players do not have her.

archetypes.name: Anti-Fart
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Dying from Bronchus? Not anymore, the DR from MoranT and the life-steal Ada gives the active B3 with Nayuta sharing it across the team makes this a hard counter for any Bronchus stage, given that your b3s do enough damage to actually heal back. The 2 free slots can be any B3 and a flex, with the ability to move Ada to flex slot and run 2 different B3s instead. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can replace Ada Wong but she needs to burst for heals.

archetypes.name: Blacked out Snake
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new BiS team against Black Snake. MoranT allows easier time tanking the boss attacks while HelmT heal back any damage done, and SwHA gets the job done. For the clones by killing one and stalling the kill on the 2nd one till HelmT burst is available to tank the spit is possible. Substitutions: Privaty Treasure may be replaced with Mast Romantic Maid, Can run Maiduo instead if no Crown. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Ziz wipe vs a Moran
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Moran replaces Maid Anchor as a more reliable tank for Ziz wipe, allowing the team to run a flex slot for more damage. HelmT heals back all the damage lost after the wipe too while helping hyper buff Rapi Red Hood to have enough damage to clear. Substitutions: Mast Romantic Maid may be replaced with Privaty Treasure. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Moran Electric
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The combination of Moran damage, buff and CDR can actually replace Rouge which is wild, while also maintaining more survivability. Substitutions: Crown may be replaced for Ade Agent Bunny or Nayuta. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Standard School Girl
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team used to be the best Campaign team, but now it lost ít's flavor.

archetypes.name: Going behind Tia's back
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is just purely better than Tiga in anyway, sadly.

archetypes.name: Heavenly Palm
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A very strong combination, especially on Wind boss with core. Without core, it depends on Nayuta to edge out Crown - Mmast variation. But at most, it's kinda equal so you can run whatever.

archetypes.name: No Crown is okay
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a weaker version of the Crown team, but sometimes Crown is not available, you can actually use this team and not Mast Anchor version. It gives better outcome depending on your Nayuta invesment (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Nayuta cleaning
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is an interesting team. Of course on high, very high deficit you will be punished harshly for bursting with Nayuta and not Crown's shield, but a moderate deficit like 35% or below, this team is pretty okay.

archetypes.name: Burn baby burn
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] It's another version of 5 RL Mihara DoT comp, except you don't need Blanc here since Nayuta has built in Indomitable. This team's win condition is surviving till Cinderellas burst and wipes everyone.

archetypes.name: I'm the wind that's coming
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 3 RL nuke version featuring Rei and doesn't need Blanc + Jackal. Rei burst on Nayuta buff + Nayuta burst damage herself should be enough to wipe everyone out. You may want a Tempering cube + SR 15 doll on Rapunzel to avoid her dying too soon. Laplace can be replaced by XMaiden but you will need Quantum cube lv 7 on both Emilia + Maiden.

archetypes.name: Counters, Assemble!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] It's a very easy to understand team: You deal big AoE damage, you kill everything on sight. Anis buffs both Neon and Rapi who have big explosion damage. Rapi and Neon are both excel in AoE and Single target pinning down. Very easy to use team Substitutions: Privaty Treasure can be replaced by M.Mast or even Snow White: Heavy Arm for faster burst gen

archetypes.name: Neon Having the Maids for Herself
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Also works in Water-weak SR, replacing Bready (old alternative team consists of SBS - Liberalio). This team features Neon receiving max Reload Speed from MastM & AnchorM while being buffed Charge Speed-wise by Liberalio. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Neon for Campaign Bosses
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Neon has basically replaced Cindy in most if not all Campaign bosses (or at least be used together). Attaining lower CP clears have never been so satisfying. She has better burst gen, can kill projectiles with basic attack, and scales better with existing meta units. Substitutions: MoranTr is used for Damage Reduction alongside Anis: Star for her heal. If Damage Reduction is not needed, remove MoranTr and use an extra buffer. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Neon Explodes Mobs in Missilis Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Missilis Tower team features 2 of the best Missilis mobbing units. Try to align NeonVE's Super Firepower Burst into the stage target, but this may not be possible at all times. Substitutions: Ein can be replaced by Quency: Escape Queen or LaplaceTr depending on the stage element.

archetypes.name: Neon Detonates Bosses in Missilis Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Missilis Tower team features 2 of the best Missilis bosssing units. Alternate-manual Tia & NeonVE for burst gen. Substitutions: Depending on the stage element, or if you don't have MiharaBC, you can use Ein, Quency: Escape Queen, or LaplaceTr.

archetypes.name: Capo Dei Capeye
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is one of the best teams for UR (usually Team 2 if you double-hit Electric-weak). In this team, Rosanna grants Damage Taken▲, and the entire team benefits from fast Reload Speed. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Schoolgirls are introduced a new career path: Robbery
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General Team 1 for Phantom. She can fit in the Tia-Naga team.

archetypes.name: Wo'ah Water Woteh
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team utilizes SMary's Elemental DMG buff to make Quency: Escape Queen more devastating, as well as her healing to keep the team healthy. The last two units are FLEX and can be other units, damage dealers & buffers alike. We use Phantom and Ludmilla Winter Owner to showcase 3 Water DPS. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: The Nuke Team for Nukers
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 3RL Nuke. Prioritizes buffing Phantom to the max with both Red Hood's Burst 1, and Blanc's Burst 2. Blanc will allow Phantom to deal any follow-up damage she can muster up the courage to deal.

archetypes.name: Zombie Queen
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 3RL Nuke. Aim is to revive Blanc when she eventually dies in P1, and opposing RLs should allow Phantom to get Indomitability from Blanc. This should pull off the nuke alongside any follow up damage Phantom can dish out.

archetypes.name: Maids Phantom
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Burst Maid Anchor with Phantom so that the other DPS can be buffed better by Maid Mast. Burst Phantom first. Substitutions: Bready can be replaced with any water DPS or meta neutral DPS. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Ludmilla: Winter Owner powercreep
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Burst Phantom first. Substitutions: Crown can be replaced with Nayuta. SWHA can be replaced with HelmTr. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Flexible Team 4/5
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Burst Phantom first. Substitutions: Quency: EQ can be replaced with any water DPS or meta neutral DPS. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Send in the Black Hawk
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] As funny as it sounds, it's 2 RL comp. This team relies solely on Moran's damage reduction, so it will wither easily against heavy nuker with buffer. Still, it can give those > 2 RL comp a hard time due to Privaty stun, and the damage burst with follow up are very strong too.

archetypes.name: Privaty, the Best Flex
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This can be anything (except water, use Privaty as damage dealer in Water please). Still, you need to beware of burst gen too because Privaty can't generate burst fast enough

archetypes.name: Water Among Us
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Very funny to see this team almost matches SBS. You can actually put Alice and SBS on duo maids instead. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: SAnis Funneling Strategy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Anis: Sparkling Summer's damage has been tested to stay uniform even with Tove in team because her ATK and ATK Speed buffs compensate for fewer S2 triggers. In this team, nonetheless, she can enjoy Leona's increased Optimal Range and CRIT Rate while also buffing Privaty: Unkind Maid's overall output.

archetypes.name: Deceptive Rosanna Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A team that can Burst as fast as 2.5 RL if Rosanna's Sacrifice ability is triggered. This team revolves around sacrificing P1, which recharges Burst Gauge, and quickly activating Rosanna's Burst Skill to pick off key targets like Noise, Noah, or DPS units. Then, Anne: Miracle Fairy will revive as well as buff Privaty: Unkind Maid, which will in turn perform a full-screen AoE to finish off the rest.

archetypes.name: Quencyyy BEAMMMMMM!!!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team focuses on overcharging Quency: Escape Queen with lots of Max Ammo and Hit Rate from Noir & Modernia (as well as Liter). With some investments and a good manual gameplay, Quency: Escape Queen's shots will turn into a laser. Note that BunnyAlice here is a troll pick and serves only to complete the true infinite ammo build. Quency: Escape Queen uses Bastion in this team.

archetypes.name: Squirt Queens
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team maximizes Quency: Escape Queen's Burst Skill buff, Crown's Reload Speed, and Resilience's effect to achieve perpetual S3 stacks that never drop even when reloading (>97.5% Reload Speed). However, this paradise only lasts when Quency: Escape Queen's Burst Skill effect is active for around 10s. Hence, you need to manage your Max Ammo well and try to only Reload when all these effects are active. Adding Privaty to the team will solve the timing issue as you can achieve Permanent Stacks every Full Burst, but she is not mandatory. The FLEX can be a healer or someone with high Burst regen since this team has a slow rotation. In this team, Quency: Escape Queen uses Resilience. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Godspeed, Lightspeed
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is derived from the OG Red Hood + Jackal Team but with Quency: Escape Queen as the main DPS. Deliver a very fast wipe with decent follow-up damage. It fears Biscuit as much as Scarlet fears Noah.

archetypes.name: Iron Man Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is very strong to deal against Iron weak, for example Ultra in A.I mode or Stormbringer/Material H in Campaign. You can both buff Rapi and gain Burst gen using Red Hood, and Liter + Helm: Aquamarine will allow you to reach no CDR faster instead of waiting at least 2 Full Burst rotations. May we use this team anywhere else? Yes, because they are so versatile (use Naga instead of Helm: Aquamarine in that case) (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fe-Male Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variation of Iron man team, but this time Rapi will play as B1. This team is used when you want to make use of your other Iron DPS, be it either Laplace (Treasure), Maxwell or Soda: Twinkling Bunny (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Firefighter
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] You can go full Fire here and have Rei to protect the team with her op shield, or relying on Liter and her cover repairing trait. Asuka or Rei can buff Modernia + Rapi and still deal good damage themselves. Substitutions: Rei can used instead of Asuka here (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Anti Nvidia
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] With the release of Rapi, Indivilla is no longer that difficult anymore. As a B1, she allows faster rotation and still deals a lot of damage to the Boss. Because you are running Rapi as B1, this team still relies on Alice doing the heavy work, with Asuka as both buffer + damage dealer. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Elysions's Saver
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Elysion Tower FINALLY as a DPS unit as Rapi saves the day for them with her new found skills! Substitutions: Helm is replacable with Phantom, Maiden: Ice Rose or Maid Privaty

archetypes.name: Zombie Rapi
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a 3 RL zombie Rapi which revolves around heavy buffing Rapi and hoping she can kill everything before Indomitable runs out. Most of the time, Rapi can trigger her S2 5 times, and unless you are fighting heavily stall team (Noah + Noise), you may win

archetypes.name: Ultra Instinct
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For AI Ultra, you can run this team because Raven deals very good damage herself, and even better when you can destroy those parts. HelmTr can be replaced with Mast Maid for better buffing. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Sisters of DoT
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The neutral team for any other boss. The FLEX spot can be Miranda Treasure if you can make sure Mihara has highest ATK, so she can afk during her own burst.

archetypes.name: Off-Burst Raven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Featuring Raven's off-burst as a variation to the OG Iron Bossing team (for Ultra). This boss spawns parts regularly, which makes off-burst Raven not a bad idea. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Standard Red DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Very strong team for Campaign, due to Red Hood piercing and Core exists

archetypes.name: Strongest Campaign Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If a stage can be cleared within 3 or fewer Burst rotations, you can choose to bring a 40s or 60s CD Burst I unit (eg Rapunzel for heals) to replace the B1-CDR unit. Alternatively, you can add another B3 instead. In this 1-1-3 team, Red Hood will act as a support buffer, replacing the B1-CDR. Do Red Hood rotation 2 times, and after that, you're left with no Burst rotation for 40s. Try to keep a small rapture alive and allow ~40 seconds to elapse so that Red Hood can Burst again. Kill the small rapture and now proceed to the Boss wave and try to kill it with the insane Crown + RedHood buff chain for your B3 units.For more information on this team, kindly visit: https://www.prydwen.gg/nikke/guides/meta-teams/

archetypes.name: Dream Modernia Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This will help Modernia shine. Both Asuka and Rei need to activate their respective Burst Skill(s) to achieve peak supportive power. Meanwhile, the only Fire unit currently that should not use Burst Skill is Modernia. This makes her the most ideal third DPS for this team. Modernia does not have too much ATK buff her in her kit, so she will definitely benefit from Rei's. Modernia also scales very well with Rei's ATK DMG and Asuka's Core DMG. Strong for Campaign and Bossing too! You can also choose to use Red Hood B1 as an alternative in Campaign, and even use Alice over Asuka if you're willing to put your fingers to the test.While Crown is the best buffer, the dilution of ATK DMG is a bit too high, and she might be better paired with other units. In case of this, S. Rosanna would be a viable alternative, due to providing an undiluted Damage Taken debuff. Substitutions: Liter => D:KW or Red HoodCrown => Grave

archetypes.name: Rei the Screen Clearing Menace
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A team for Wind Weak Campaign stages. Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name) can be used as a screen clear unit, with Red Hood as B1 buffing her damage. The other B3 can be any unit you like here that can deal enough damage or perform the job you want them to do so that you clear the stage. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Maids Ahoy!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mast and Anchor are the 2nd best buffers for non Core Bosses. They also provide heals, reload speed and Burst gen so that Asuka and Rei can have a more lenient time when it comes to OL gear, and can just focus on dealing damage. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: 2RL Snipe with Ele
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team focuses on cleaning units with the help of elemental damage on OL gear. Units like Jackal, Red Hood, Centi, Rapunzel, Laplace (Treasure), Crown or Liter are often seen being used in PvP. A 2RL fast Snow Whiteipe can deal massive damage with the help of elemental damage, and can possibly break the Burst chain before the opponent even Bursts! Anne: Miracle Fairy, and especially Blanc, can help ensure that enough damage is dealt after the Burst Nuke that whoever is left alive can be taken care of.

archetypes.name: The WaterWorks Squad
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Full Water team! Ludmilla Winter Owner buffs the team while Rem buffs Emilia. Emilia can be changed to Anis: Sparkling Summer if you're planning to use this team for Union Raid since she is a better damage dealer and parts are usually weak in Union Raids unless you have a low sync level. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Rosanna-Only Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Rosanna will support (and deal tons of damage herself) 2 other Electric DPS. B2 can be either Crown or Ade as long as it's Attack Damage buff. B1 CDR should be someone with low-value Burst, so you can Burst Rosanna every other rotation. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Summer Solstice
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The two summer units have high synergy together! S. Rosanna buffs S. Sakura extremely well. Her Damage Taken debuff, paired with extra Parts Damage buffs, as well as the Sustained Damage buff are all highly appreciated. Combined, they allow S. Sakura to deal immense damage to opponents. This buffs S. Sakura beyond what most other teams can, even higher than the famous bunny duo!

archetypes.name: 2~2.5~3RL Simple Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Scarlet team is 2.5RL at base, 2RL with feed or Quantum Cubes. S. Sakura team is 3RL at base, 2.5 with feed. Fast-buffed Nukes to wipe off slower teams quickly. Expensive, but it saves Blanc.

archetypes.name: Anis Holds a Summer Party
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Tetra Tower Squad. With the removal of Noir, S. Anis can finally enjoy Blanc's buffs without bricking herself. With Rouge, she can be added to your Tetra Tower squad without any loss of DPS and can effectively be used as a B3.

archetypes.name: Typical 2 RL nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is nothing new. We just replaced Anis (SR Version) with Rumani which is SSR. With the same investment, any SSR will have 20% more stat than the SR version in the same role. And at least Rumani can bring “something” to the table instead of Anis.

archetypes.name: Electric team goes Zzzttt
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team consists of 3 Electric units which are Moran, Biscuit and Anis: Sparkling Summer. Anis: Sparkling Summer will heavily buff the Electric unit which benefits from Biscuit too. And you have Moran in P1 to protect against any funny Scarlet Black Shadow. Moran’s damage reduction helps against nukes too, and once Anis: Sparkling Summer has lifesteal, she should be able to tank a lot.
