Very annoying team, and Moran is better than Noise here because she’s Defender.

archetypes.name: Can it go faster?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This one is very tricky - the more quantum Cubes you put on those batteries (Noah + Jackal + Rumani), the faster it can be, up to 2.4 RL. It has an insane ATK buff from Red Hood, insane protection from Noah, and the Snow Whiteeep from Quency: Escape Queen/Scarlet. Pretty scary one to deal with.

archetypes.name: The Bunny Duo
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While Tia's Attack Damage buff and Naga's ATK buff are highly appreciated, Tia and Naga are Core-hit buffers and are better suited to units that hit the Core more often. However, S. Sakura's passive damage comes from skills instead of Core hits. On the other hand, Blanc and Noir help S. Sakura the same as they would benefit any other unit. Maxwell boosts S. Sakura's output, while Modernia in general performs exceptionally well in the bunny team due to Noir's Max Ammo buffs.

archetypes.name: Partners in Wind
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team was seen being used as a meta team for Wind Weak Solo Raids. Red Hood acts as a B1 unit for one of Sakura or Mana, whoever is dealing more damage. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Making Use of DoT with Stall (3RL)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Noir, Soda: Twinkling Bunny, and Drake are the best choices for Clip SG here. Hits less harder as the previous team but you save some critical resources. Again, will fare well against Noah-less teams, but otherwise may struggle.

archetypes.name: Scarlet's Screen Wipe - A menace for Campaign
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the most useful tool to have at your disposal in Campaign is a screen clear. There is barely anyone who does it better than our very own OG Scarlet! (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: General new bossing team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Trina is the new Scarlet buffer who lets her deal enough damage to compete in the current meta. The problem is that Trina buffs ONLY Scarlet, so maybe it is better to just form a team around her here. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: The best 2RL team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Scarlet's 2rl nukes are the hardest to deal with, especially in champions arena. They proved to be highly effective. Substitutions: Blanc can replace Trina.

archetypes.name: Basic Siren comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The basic comp for Siren, featuring the backbone Crown - Helm - Siren and 2 more DPS based on situation. This team can run on Campaign, Bossing, AI too.

archetypes.name: Pillaging the Harvester
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp is tailored for A.I Harvester. Depending your Helm/Ludmilla Winter Owner, you will want to Burst them. Rapi should be B3 here, with either Helm or Ludmilla Winter Owner act as non Burst DPS. Just pay attention if you want to Burst with Helm, her Burst will hit normal mob so clear them first. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Release the Kraken
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Another version to deal with A.I Kraken. Pretty much controlling Siren and just aim the Core. Trying to break 4 first tentacles as soon as possible to reach phase 2 for permanent Core uptime. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Ultra Pro Max
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For Ultra, you can run this one. Replacing Helm with... Helm Summer version if you have her S2 at lv 10. Again, reaching phase 2 asap to access Core easier. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Siren Hypercarry
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp is a Siren hypercarry comp that has proven to score better than the standard Siren Crown AsukaW ReiT DeltaNT (and their Velvet variants). Since Velvets Burst doesnt provide buffs, we use B3 buffers to avoid individual damage loss. DPS investment on Velvet is required. Siren & Velvet must be well invested. Demo (Sub to him!): Youtube Substitutions: If you want to free up Crown, you can use an off-burst buffer or a B1 with better Burst than Siren's. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Snow Crane PVE team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Beside being heal bot for Crown, we can't think of a team where you will use her unless your pulls are insanely unlucky. But if you have Crown, we suggest using another Nikke instead of Snow Crane as off burst slot.

archetypes.name: Snow Crane PVP team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If you put Quantum cube lv 7 on Snow White here and Helm treasure with max S1, this team can reach 2 RL easily, with decent buff on SWHA and decent protection by Crane.

archetypes.name: Drizzle White
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An alternative to the DWife variant with fewer team buffs in exchange for a stronger CDR and a minor teamwide heal. Soline allows this team to work in Water-weak without HelmTr. Tests have shown Soline teams to be slightly stronger. Substitutions: Maxwell or other B3 can be used in place of Ada Wong. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Snow Water Goddess
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team chews through Harvester AI like Snow White seeing a fat worm. Snow White will take care of the pesky mobs and solo kill Harvester herself. If you want to achieve a faster run, you will need to time Helm's Burst not to hit a mob. Substitutions: Siren may be replaced by Rapi: Red Hood, Mast Romantic Maid may be replaced with Elegg: Boom and Shock. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: 1.5 RL PvP Gang
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is so fast, I kneel. Still, if you really want 1.5 RL, you may need a lot of CS on everyone. The nice point of this team is Snow with Blanc buff should be able to wipe unless it's a heavy stall team.

archetypes.name: Off-Burst Snow
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Snow White can replace HelmTr here as off-burst B3, because she has insane burst gen and better off-burst DPS than Helm for sure. You will lose a bit bonus Attack Damage from Crown's S2, though.

archetypes.name: Crit White
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team works the same: abuses the Crit buff of Miranda to make one shot of Snow worth the strike. You will need a good number of skill books on Miranda to make this work, and only the first shot (+ 15 Sequential Attacks afterward). 2nd shot won't have 100% Crit Rate. Substitutions: Ada Wong may be replaced with Helm Treasure.

archetypes.name: Rainbow Six Siege
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Neutral Bossing comp for Solo Raid. Harnesses XDiesel's Damage Taken on her Burst by using units that have good off-burst damage. SWHA must Burst first. Substitutions: You can use any B1/B2. ATK-buffer B1/B2 scale better with XDiesel & Lib, while ATK-DMG ones scale better with SWHA.Crown may replace Liberalio, but the point of this team is for Raid (Neutral T5 comp), so you're not using Crown there.

archetypes.name: Rainbow Six Siege 2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Neutral Bossing comp for Solo Raid, but you insist on using Cindy. This team is worse than the one without Cindy (unless against Electric-weak).

archetypes.name: One We Have Coveted Since 2023
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The BiS team for Soda. The SG God Comp. This is what you will see being used in Solo Raids or Union Raids due to the support structure not clashing with the 2 strongest pairs: Bunnies and Tove-Drake

archetypes.name: Fus So Dah!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 3RL team, can reach 2.5RL if against opponents that feed into Jackal. High power nuke, similar to those of Privaty: Unkind Maid, Maiden, or Harran. Soda: Twinkling Bunny has lower final value of nuke compared to if using the other units, however has higher follow-up DPS compared to others (if used with Blanc).

archetypes.name: Soline Makes Vesti Launch Torpedoes
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the basic Absolute formation with Soline as CDR to help with Water QTE breaking. EmmaTU already heals, though, so using Soline is less incentivizing here, but Soline gives great CDR! (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: General Summer Anis team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General Summer Anis team comp for players who dont have Noise. Sora can comfortably slot in the P2 slot to allow for a 3RL team comp.

archetypes.name: True Damage Cope (Again)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A solid team in Solo Raid Iron weak. Very comfortable to use with Moran damage reduction, Takina burst gen and small heal from Ada to 2 DPS. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: The Reason Takina SS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Takina doesn't burst. Her value lies in the 140% true damage buff every 15s, which lasts 10s. Put in on top of Vesti = killing everything on screen.

archetypes.name: Scarlet Treasure
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new general team composition for PvE whenever Scarlet is relevant. B3 can be any unit that can do the job for the stage or Boss, but will mostly depend on game mode. Rapi: Red Hood, Liter, and Volume are popular pairings alongside Scarlet for B1-CDR. A Doro-Priv team to allow Scarlet to achieve 100% Reload Speed is also not a bad idea if there are Boss Parts. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Electric Wombo Combo #73
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A highly competitive Bossing team, where we utilise Trina’s unique Max HP buff to buff Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose. This team may also be the key team for Infinite Mode in Overclock for Electric, whenever it comes. Substitutions: Anis: Sparkling Summer can replace Maiden: Ice Rose (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Off-Burst Menace!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Scarlet can also be used as an Off-Burst unit in Bossing. On occasions when there is no Core, Anis: Sparkling Summer gains more damage as Main B3 and hence it would be ideal to just use Scarlet as an Off-Burst unit especially if the player does not have Maiden: Ice Rose. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Campaign Shenanigans ft. Trina
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best team for Scarlet in PvE is still with Crown. In Campaign, if she is relevant or if you want to use her, simply use Trina Burst with Scarlet and Crown Burst with the other B3.

archetypes.name: Prepare for Nukes! And Make Them double!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team needs immense investment to work properly as a 2RL hyper-fast nuke. Both Scarlet and Rosanna need to be SR15 to match Helm Treasure’s ATK stat. Both of them, in fact, need to beat Helm’s ATK stat so that they can get the Jackal link over Helm. This way, Rosanna and Scarlet are now ready to devastate the whole enemy team!

archetypes.name: God Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This one is currently the god team, with insane amount of strongest buff possible, with decent heal. Mostly reserved for 2 best DPS, but you can always ignore meta and put Trony here. The reload buff helps Trony fast tap playstyle to fill as many S1 as possible, and the Core hit buffs help her reach the S1 cap faster, allowing for more nukes during Burst!

archetypes.name: Average Counter-Strike Gameplay
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Traumatized by your Counter-Strike (who plays that game anymore anyway) matches where enemies dominate you with 5 AWP? Well, now you can form your own CS Team in NIKKE, sponsored by Mustang! Substitutions: BAde can be replaced by Blanc.

archetypes.name: Best Wind-Weak Bosser (Singular Team)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The BiS Wind-Weak Bossing comp for Singular Team content like Campaign, Interception, and UR (ideally, you hit each element once). Charge Speed & Max Ammo on Velvet enables Siren to deal more damage. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: DeltaNT Powercrept in 3.5 Months
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Siren Crown AsukaW ReiT DeltaNT was the meta for one Solo Raid. DeltaNT has now been toppled over by Velvet. This team is actually not ideal for Solo Raid because Velvet should be a DPS, but it's the second best if you don't have her DPS-built. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: The good, the bad and the Demon
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A general team for the Absolute Trio. It will only show up in Fire weak, with 1 flex DPS and 1 CDR. Vesti bossing power is so bad we don't even know if you should build this team (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: I'm inevitable
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a fast stall team, with Vesti deals explosive DPS damage so even Noah won't be able to block. Problem is it will lose against 2 buffers stall team, or Nero-Moran. Still a decent one.

archetypes.name: What if SG splash?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team featuring 3 strongest splash RL currently, which with decent ATK amount (20+%) can kill many Nikkes in P1, P2 and P3 within 2~3 shots. This is a proper functional team, but you can put Makima + XMaiden instead of Blanc and Rapunzel to pressure even more.

archetypes.name: Absolute Vesti
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Is this trolling? Sadly no, this is one of the most brutal way to snipe 3 enemies pre burst. The trio immediately unlocks 60% true damage buff for Vesti, which will brutalize 3 postions immediately the moment she shoots

archetypes.name: Vesti the Mobber
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Vesti the Besti is here to clear all the mobs she can, with rapi to help her for the single target damage! Ultimate mob destroyer team, and auto-friendly as well. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Snow White goes to school
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Bossing team. Direct subsitute for Miranda. Weaker to Miranda if the player does fully optimised crit runs. Upgrade to Miranda in average runs where players do not mald for crit. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Snow White goes to school, again!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A unique bossing team for sure, but one that definitely works. The highest Zwei team in the recent Altruia Solo Raid, it makes use of Mast's ATK buff and Summer Helm's Damage taken buff. It proves to be better than using Grave or Bunny Ade. Zwei's Cover heal allows for the team to survive any incoming damage, since SW and MW both can cover without serious damage loss for the team. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Double the Non-CDR B1s!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] We saw a unique pairing of B2s before, and now it's a unique pair of B1s!Miranda's ATK and Crit Damage buffs paired with Zwei's Pierce Damage buffs = a combo worth trying out. While currently only Summer Helm exists as a viable B2-CDR, this team can probably be more effective in the future with a more potent B2-CDR! (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Firey Core Rings
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Both Alice, Asuka and Grave can take advantage of Zwei's pierce damage buffs here. There is less dilution here since Zwei cannot stack her Skill 1 fast enough. Hence, pairing Grave Asuka and Alice together can prove useful, especially if it is a boss with core and pierce both being available! Such a boss already exists in Museum: Stormbringer! (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Liquid Holes
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Water-Weak content can also make use of Zwei's Pierce damage buffs with Snow White: Heavy Arms. However, it might require very particular scenarios, such as Blacksmith's double core, to make Snow White's normal weapon type potent enough to deal relevant damage. (속성: Water)

synergyPairs.reason: 메이드 듀오. 무조건부 공격버프 + 힐 + 재장전 속도 증가로 탄약 관리 부담을 없애줌.

버스트II 2인 콤보로 커뮤니티에서 잘 알려진 조합. 크라운의 버스트 쿨타임(20초)이 항상 먼저 준비되기 때문에 오토에 맡기면 크라운만 계속 버스트를 쓰고 마스트의 버스트(강력한 공격버프)는 거의 발동하지 않는다 — 크라운 버스트 직후 곧바로 마스트 버스트를 수동으로 눌러줘야 실제로 발동한다. 마스트는 이 조합이 없어도 1/2스킬 버프만으로 이미 훌륭하므로 필수 조합은 아니며, 수동 버스트 조작이 가능한 유저에게 추천되는 강화 픽이다.
강력한 버프를 주고받지만 두 캐릭터가 세트로 있어야 성능이 나오는 경직적 페어.
딜러를 크게 가리지 않는 범용 버스트I+II 코어. 주의: 크라운을 보유하고 있다면 크라운이 이 페어의 상위호환이므로 크라운을 대신 채택하고 이 페어(특히 티아)는 제외할 것 — 크라운이 버스트II를 가져가면 나가는 토템으로 전환되어 이 페어의 전제(둘 다 실제 버스트를 발동하는 코어)가 깨진다.
즈바이 트레저의 크리티컬 부족을 민트가 정확히 메꿔줌.
델타의 받는피해 증가 디버프가 크라운 S2 반복 발동을 도움.
전기/철 속성 보스전 핵심 지원 페어.
나가의 코어뎀 버프는 코어뎀 스케일링 딜러(신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브)에만 유의미.
고정 데미지 버프를 주고받는 상호의존 듀오, PvP 순간딜 특화.
라피의 화력에 헬름 트레저의 버스트 생성/힐이 더해지는 표준 화력조합 페어.
레드후드B1의 공격버프가 홍련의 순삭형 버스트 데미지를 극대화.
맥스웰의 지속 공격버프가 라피 같은 하이퍼캐리 딜러와 잘 맞음.
맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉의 최대체력 버프가 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로의 생존력을 보강해 PVP 폭딜 타이밍을 확보해주는 조합. 국내 유튜버(스페란도)가 루주·트리나와 함께 반복 소개(2026-07-31 기준, 후속 확인 필요).
